q: How many surahs are in the Quran?
كَمْ عَدَدُ سُوَرِ القُرْآنِ الكَرِيمِ؟
x: The Mushaf holds 114 surahs, opening with Al-Fatihah. After it, the surahs run roughly from the longest to the shortest, so the last pages hold the short surahs many of us memorize first.

يَضُمُّ المُصْحَفُ 114 سُورَةً، أَوَّلُهَا الفَاتِحَةُ، ثُمَّ تَتَرَتَّبُ السُّوَرُ فِي الغَالِبِ مِنَ الطِّوَالِ إِلَى القِصَارِ، فَفِي آخِرِهِ السُّوَرُ القَصِيرَةُ الَّتِي يَحْفَظُهَا كَثِيرُونَ أَوَّلًا.

q: Which surah opens the Mushaf?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي يُفْتَتَحُ بِهَا المُصْحَفُ؟
x: Al-Fatihah means “The Opening”, and its seven verses open the Mushaf. It begins with praise of Allah and ends with a duʿa asking Him for guidance.
الفَاتِحَةُ سُمِّيَتْ بِذَلِكَ لِأَنَّ المُصْحَفَ يُفْتَتَحُ بِهَا، وَهِيَ سَبْعُ آيَاتٍ، تَبْدَأُ بِحَمْدِ اللَّهِ وَتُخْتَمُ بِدُعَاءِ الهِدَايَةِ.

q: Which surah begins with ﴾Say, He is Allah, the One﴿?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي تَبْدَأُ بِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {Q:112:1}؟
x: In just four verses, Al-Ikhlas describes Allah: He is One, the Eternal Refuge, He neither begets nor was begotten, and nothing is comparable to Him.
فِي أَرْبَعِ آيَاتٍ فَقَطْ تَصِفُ سُورَةُ الإِخْلَاصِ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى: {Q:112:1} {Q:112:2} {Q:112:3} {Q:112:4}.

q: In which month was the Quran sent down?
فِي أَيِّ شَهْرٍ أُنْزِلَ القُرْآنُ؟
x: Allah says the Quran was sent down in the month of Ramadan as guidance for mankind, with clear proofs of guidance and of the criterion between right and wrong.

q: The Quran was revealed in the Arabic language.
نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ الكَرِيمُ بِاللِّسَانِ العَرَبِيِّ.
x: True. Allah says He sent it down as an Arabic Quran so that people may understand, and elsewhere describes it as revealed ﴾in a clear Arabic tongue.﴿

q: Which surah comes second in the Mushaf?
مَا السُّورَةُ الثَّانِيَةُ فِي تَرْتِيبِ المُصْحَفِ؟
x: Al-Baqarah means “The Cow”. It is named after the story in it where Musa told his people that Allah commanded them to slaughter a cow, and they kept asking questions to avoid it.
البَقَرَةُ تَعْنِي البَقَرَةَ الَّتِي أُمِرَ قَوْمُ مُوسَى بِذَبْحِهَا، فَأَكْثَرُوا الأَسْئِلَةَ تَهَرُّبًا. قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:2:67:1-10}.

q: Al-Fatihah is the longest surah in the Quran.
الفَاتِحَةُ أَطْوَلُ سُورَةٍ فِي القُرْآنِ.
x: False. Al-Fatihah is short, just seven verses. The long surahs come right after it, at the start of the Mushaf.
خَطَأٌ. الفَاتِحَةُ قَصِيرَةٌ، سَبْعُ آيَاتٍ فَقَطْ، وَالسُّوَرُ الطِّوَالُ تَأْتِي بَعْدَهَا فِي أَوَّلِ المُصْحَفِ.

q: Into how many parts (juzʾ) is the Mushaf divided?
إِلَى كَمْ جُزْءًا يُقَسَّمُ المُصْحَفُ؟
x: The Mushaf is divided into 30 equal parts (juzʾ), each made of two hizbs. That makes it easy to recite the whole Quran in a month, one juzʾ a day.
يُقَسَّمُ المُصْحَفُ إِلَى 30 جُزْءًا، فِي كُلِّ جُزْءٍ حِزْبَانِ، فَيَسْهُلُ خَتْمُهُ فِي شَهْرٍ بِقِرَاءَةِ جُزْءٍ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ.

q: Which book was sent down to Muhammad {saw}?
مَا الكِتَابُ الَّذِي نَزَلَ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ {saw}؟
x: The Quran was revealed to Muhammad {saw} in stages, over many years. Allah says He divided it so that it would be recited to people slowly.
نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ {saw} مُنَجَّمًا عَلَى سَنَوَاتٍ. قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:17:106:1-7}.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾And from the evil of those who blow on knots﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:113:4}؟
x: Al-Falaq teaches seeking refuge in the Lord of daybreak from four evils: the evil of what He created, the darkness when it settles, those who blow on knots, and the envier when he envies.
تُعَلِّمُنَا سُورَةُ الفَلَقِ الاِسْتِعَاذَةَ بِرَبِّ الفَلَقِ مِنْ أَرْبَعَةِ شُرُورٍ: {Q:113:2} {Q:113:3} {Q:113:4} {Q:113:5}.

q: Surah Ya-Sin is the first surah in the Mushaf.
سُورَةُ يس أَوَّلُ سُورَةٍ فِي المُصْحَفِ.
x: False. The Mushaf opens with Al-Fatihah. Ya-Sin is surah 36, named after the two Arabic letters its first verse consists of: Ya and Sin.
خَطَأٌ. أَوَّلُ المُصْحَفِ الفَاتِحَةُ، وَيس هِيَ السُّورَةُ السَّادِسَةُ وَالثَّلَاثُونَ، وَسُمِّيَتْ بِاسْمِ الحَرْفَيْنِ اللَّذَيْنِ تَبْدَأُ بِهِمَا: {Q:36:1}.

q: Complete Al-Fatihah: ﴾Guide us to the…﴿
أَكْمِلْ مِنْ سُورَةِ الفَاتِحَةِ: {Q:1:6:1} ...
x: Every Muslim asks this in every prayer. The very next verse explains the straight path: the path of those You have blessed, not of those who earned anger, nor of those who went astray.
دُعَاءٌ يُرَدِّدُهُ المُسْلِمُ فِي كُلِّ صَلَاةٍ، وَالآيَةُ بَعْدَهُ تُفَسِّرُ الصِّرَاطَ: {Q:1:7}.

q: Complete: ﴾You alone we worship, and You alone…﴿
x: This verse is the core of Al-Fatihah: worship and asking for help belong to Allah alone.
هَذِهِ الآيَةُ قَلْبُ الفَاتِحَةِ: العِبَادَةُ وَالاِسْتِعَانَةُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ.

q: Complete: ﴾Allah, the…﴿
x: “As-Samad” means the Eternal Refuge: the One everyone turns to, who needs no one. Surprisingly, this name appears only once in the whole Quran, here.
«الصمد» اسْمٌ لَمْ يَرِدْ فِي القُرْآنِ كُلِّهِ إِلَّا فِي هَذِهِ الآيَةِ مِنْ سُورَةِ الإِخْلَاصِ: {Q:112:2}.

q: Complete: ﴾He neither begets, nor…﴿
x: Allah has no children and no parents. The surah then closes: ﴾And there is none comparable to Him.﴿
اللَّهُ لَا وَلَدَ لَهُ وَلَا وَالِدَ، ثُمَّ تُخْتَمُ السُّورَةُ بِقَوْلِهِ: {Q:112:4}.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾From the evil of the retreating whisperer﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:114:4}؟
x: An-Nas seeks refuge in the Lord, King and God of mankind from the whisperer who withdraws, the one who whispers into people’s hearts.
سُورَةُ النَّاسِ اسْتِعَاذَةٌ بِرَبِّ النَّاسِ وَمَلِكِهِمْ وَإِلَهِهِمْ مِنَ الوَسْوَاسِ الخَنَّاسِ: {Q:114:5}.

q: Complete: ﴾By time! Indeed, mankind is in…﴿
x: Allah swears by time that every human being is in loss, except those with four qualities named in the next verse. It is one of the shortest surahs, yet it holds a whole way of life.
أَقْسَمَ اللَّهُ بِالعَصْرِ أَنَّ الإِنْسَانَ فِي خُسْرٍ، إِلَّا مَنِ اتَّصَفَ بِأَرْبَعِ صِفَاتٍ تَذْكُرُهَا الآيَةُ التَّالِيَةُ. سُورَةٌ قَصِيرَةٌ، لَكِنَّهَا مَنْهَجُ حَيَاةٍ كَامِلٌ.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:108:3}؟
x: Al-Kawthar opens with a gift from Allah: ﴾Indeed, We have given you al-Kawthar.﴿ It then assures the Prophet {saw} that it is his enemy, not he, who is cut off.
تَبْدَأُ السُّورَةُ بِالعَطَاءِ: {Q:108:1}، وَتُخْتَمُ بِطَمْأَنَةِ النَّبِيِّ {saw}: {Q:108:3}.

q: Complete Surah Al-ʿAsr: ﴾…and advise one another to truth, and advise one another to…﴿
x: Four qualities save a person: faith, good deeds, advising one another to truth, and advising one another to patience. The whole surah is only three verses long.
أَرْبَعُ صِفَاتٍ تُنْجِي صَاحِبَهَا: الإِيمَانُ، وَالعَمَلُ الصَّالِحُ، وَالتَّوَاصِي بِالحَقِّ، وَالتَّوَاصِي بِالصَّبْرِ. وَالسُّورَةُ كُلُّهَا ثَلَاثُ آيَاتٍ فَقَطْ.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Your Lord has not forsaken you, nor is He displeased﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:93:3}؟
x: Allah swears by the morning brightness and the still night, then comforts the Prophet {saw}: your Lord has not abandoned you. The next verse adds: ﴾And the Hereafter is better for you than the first life.﴿
أَقْسَمَ اللَّهُ بِالضُّحَى وَاللَّيْلِ، ثُمَّ طَمْأَنَ نَبِيَّهُ {saw}، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {Q:93:4}.

q: Complete: ﴾All praise is for Allah, Lord of the…﴿
x: The Quran’s first words of praise: Allah is Lord of all the worlds, every part of creation. The next verse calls Him ﴾the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful.﴿
أَوَّلُ حَمْدٍ فِي المُصْحَفِ: اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَالَمِينَ جَمِيعًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {Q:1:3}.

q: Complete: ﴾Did We not expand for you your…﴿
x: This surah comforts the Prophet {saw}: Allah expanded his chest, lifted his burden, and raised his mention.
هَذِهِ السُّورَةُ تَسْلِيَةٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ {saw}: شَرَحَ اللَّهُ صَدْرَهُ، وَوَضَعَ عَنْهُ وِزْرَهُ، وَرَفَعَ لَهُ ذِكْرَهُ: {Q:94:4}.

q: Which is the longest surah in the Quran?
مَا أَطْوَلُ سُورَةٍ فِي القُرْآنِ الكَرِيمِ؟
x: Al-Baqarah has 286 verses, and it ends with some of the most beloved duʿas in the Quran.
سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ، وَعَدَدُ آيَاتِهَا 286 آيَةً.

q: Which surah does not begin with “Bismillah”?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي لَا تَبْدَأُ بِالبَسْمَلَةِ؟
x: At-Tawbah (Surah 9) is the only surah that does not open with Bismillah.
سُورَةُ التَّوْبَةِ هِيَ السُّورَةُ الوَحِيدَةُ الَّتِي لَا تُفْتَتَحُ بِالبَسْمَلَةِ.

q: Ayat al-Kursi is found in which surah?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ تَقَعُ آيَةُ الكُرْسِيِّ؟
x: It is verse 255 of Al-Baqarah: a single verse about Allah’s life, knowledge and power, ending ﴾and He is the Most High, the Most Great﴿.
آيَةُ الكُرْسِيِّ هِيَ الآيَةُ 255 مِنْ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ.

q: Who is the only woman mentioned by name in the Quran?
مَنِ المَرْأَةُ الوَحِيدَةُ الَّتِي ذُكِرَ اسْمُهَا صَرَاحَةً فِي القُرْآنِ؟
x: Maryam, the mother of ʿIsa {as}. Allah says He chose her and purified her above the women of the worlds, and a whole surah carries her name.
مَرْيَمُ أُمُّ عِيسَى {as}، وَقَدْ سُمِّيَتْ سُورَةٌ بِاسْمِهَا.

q: Laylat al-Qadr is better than how many months?
لَيْلَةُ القَدْرِ خَيْرٌ مِنْ كَمْ شَهْرٍ؟
x: One night better than a thousand months, more than eighty years of worship. The surah ends: it is peace until the rise of dawn.

q: Which surah tells one prophet’s story from beginning to end, and opens with ﴾We relate to you the best of stories﴿?
أَيُّ سُورَةٍ تَقُصُّ قِصَّةَ نَبِيٍّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْ أَوَّلِهَا إِلَى آخِرِهَا، وَفِي مَطْلَعِهَا: {Q:12:3:1-5}؟
x: The surah follows Yusuf {as} from a boy’s dream to the day his family bowed before him in Egypt.
السُّورَةُ كُلُّهَا فِي قِصَّةِ يُوسُفَ {as}.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Striking them with stones of baked clay﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:105:4}؟
x: Al-Fil recalls the Companions of the Elephant: Allah foiled their plot and sent birds in flocks against them.
سُورَةُ الفِيلِ، الآيَةُ 4.

q: Which surah is named after a metal that Allah says has great strength and benefits for people?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي سُمِّيَتْ بِاسْمِ مَعْدِنٍ ذَكَرَ اللَّهُ أَنَّ فِيهِ بَأْسًا شَدِيدًا وَمَنَافِعَ لِلنَّاسِ؟
x: Al-Hadid means “iron”. Allah says He sent down iron, with great strength and benefits for people.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾He who created death and life to test you, which of you is best in deed﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:67:2:1-8}؟
x: The surah opens by praising Allah, in whose hand is all dominion. Life and death are a test of who does best.
سُورَةُ المُلْكِ، الآيَةُ 2.

q: Which surah is named after the creature Allah inspired to make homes in the mountains?
أَيُّ سُورَةٍ سُمِّيَتْ بِاسْمِ مَخْلُوقٍ أَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ مِنَ الجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا؟
x: Allah inspired the bee to make homes in the mountains, in the trees and in what people build.

q: In which surah is a birth by the trunk of a palm tree described?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:19:23:1-5}؟
x: The birth of ʿIsa {as} by the palm tree is told in Surah Maryam.
تُرْوَى وِلَادَةُ عِيسَى {as} عِنْدَ جِذْعِ النَّخْلَةِ فِي سُورَةِ مَرْيَمَ.

q: Which surah mentions the journeys of winter and summer?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي تَذْكُرُ {Q:106:2:2-4}؟
x: Allah reminds Quraysh of their safe trade journeys, so they should worship the Lord of this House, who fed them and gave them security.
تُذَكِّرُ سُورَةُ قُرَيْشٍ قُرَيْشًا بِرِحْلَتَيْهِمْ فِي الشِّتَاءِ وَالصَّيْفِ.

q: Which surah begins ﴾Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?﴿?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي تَبْدَأُ بِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {Q:107:1}؟
x: The surah describes the one who denies the Recompense: he drives away the orphan and does not urge feeding the poor.
هِيَ سُورَةُ المَاعُونِ، السُّورَةُ رَقْمُ 107 فِي المُصْحَفِ.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Then you will surely be asked that Day about the pleasures﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:102:8}؟
x: The surah warns against being distracted by competing for more, until people reach the graves.
سُورَةُ التَّكَاثُرِ، الآيَةُ 8.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾The Day people will be like scattered moths﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:101:4}؟
x: The surah describes the Striking Day: people like scattered moths, and mountains like tufts of carded wool.
سُورَةُ القَارِعَةِ، الآيَةُ 4.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:99:7}؟
x: On the Day the earth shakes, even an atom’s weight of good will be seen, and an atom’s weight of evil too.
سُورَةُ الزَّلْزَلَةِ، الآيَةُ 7.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾The angels and the Spirit descend therein by permission of their Lord﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:97:4}؟
x: On that night the angels descend by their Lord’s permission, and it is peace until the rise of dawn.
سُورَةُ القَدْرِ، الآيَةُ 4.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Who gathers wealth and counts it﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:104:2}؟
x: The surah warns the slanderer who hoards and counts his wealth, thinking it will make him last forever.
سُورَةُ الهُمَزَةِ، الآيَةُ 2.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾He has succeeded who purifies it﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:91:9}؟
x: After eleven oaths, by the sun, the moon, the day, the night and more, Allah declares: whoever purifies his soul succeeds, and whoever corrupts it fails.
سُورَةُ الشَّمْسِ، الآيَةُ 9.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, your efforts are diverse﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:92:4}؟
x: People strive in different ways. Whoever gives and is mindful of Allah, and believes in the best, Allah eases his way to ease.
سُورَةُ اللَّيْلِ، الآيَةُ 4.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾We will make you recite, and you will not forget﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:87:6}؟
x: A promise to the Prophet {saw} that he would not forget the Quran, except what Allah wills.
سُورَةُ الأَعْلَى، الآيَةُ 6.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Do they not look at the camels, how they were created?﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:88:17}؟
x: The surah invites reflection on creation: the camels, the sky raised high, the mountains set firm, the earth spread out.
سُورَةُ الغَاشِيَةِ، الآيَةُ 17.

q: In which surah does “Bismillah” appear twice?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ تَتَكَرَّرُ البَسْمَلَةُ مَرَّتَيْنِ؟
x: Once at its start, and again in the letter of Sulayman {as} to the Queen of Sheba.
فِي أَوَّلِهَا، وَفِي كِتَابِ سُلَيْمَانَ {as} إِلَى مَلِكَةِ سَبَأٍ.

q: Which surah closes the Mushaf?
مَا آخِرُ سُورَةٍ فِي المُصْحَفِ؟
x: An-Nas closes the Mushaf, just as Al-Fatihah opens it: both are prayers addressed to Allah.
سُورَةُ النَّاسِ هِيَ السُّورَةُ 114، وَفِيهَا الاِسْتِعَاذَةُ بِاللَّهِ.

q: What were the first verses of the Quran to be revealed?
مَا أَوَّلُ مَا نَزَلَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ؟
o: “Read in the name of your Lord who created”
“In the name of Allah, the Most Merciful”
“All praise is for Allah, Lord of the worlds”
x: The opening verses of Surah Al-ʿAlaq came to him in the Cave of Hiraʾ.
نَزَلَتْ أَوَائِلُ سُورَةِ العَلَقِ عَلَيْهِ فِي غَارِ حِرَاءٍ.

q: Which prophet is named most often in the Quran?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ ذُكِرَ اسْمُهُ فِي القُرْآنِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ غَيْرِهِ؟
x: Musa {as} is named more than 130 times, and his story with Firʿawn is retold across many surahs.
ذُكِرَ اسْمُ مُوسَى {as} أَكْثَرَ مِنْ 130 مَرَّةً.

q: Besides the People of the Cave, Surah Al-Kahf tells of which ruler who travelled to the east and the west?
إِلَى جَانِبِ أَصْحَابِ الكَهْفِ، تَرْوِي سُورَةُ الكَهْفِ قِصَّةَ أَيِّ حَاكِمٍ بَلَغَ مَغْرِبَ الشَّمْسِ وَمَطْلِعَهَا؟
x: He travelled to where the sun sets and where it rises, and built a barrier of iron and molten copper against Yaʾjuj and Maʾjuj.
بَنَى ذُو القَرْنَيْنِ سَدًّا فِي وَجْهِ يَأْجُوجَ وَمَأْجُوجَ.

q: Which surah begins ﴾Alif Lam Mim. That is the Book, about which there is no doubt﴿?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي تَبْدَأُ بِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {Q:2:1} {Q:2:2:1-5}؟
x: Several surahs open with Alif Lam Mim, but only Al-Baqarah continues ﴾That is the Book, about which there is no doubt.﴿
تَبْدَأُ عِدَّةُ سُوَرٍ بِـ«الم»، وَلَكِنَّ سُورَةَ البَقَرَةِ وَحْدَهَا تَلِيهَا: {Q:2:2:1-5}.

q: In which surah does ʿIsa {as} give glad tidings of a messenger to come after him, named Ahmad?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ بَشَّرَ عِيسَى {as} بِرَسُولٍ يَأْتِي مِنْ بَعْدِهِ {Q:61:6:23-24}؟
x: ʿIsa {as} told the Children of Israel he brings glad tidings of a messenger after him whose name is Ahmad.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾When you are told to make room in gatherings, make room; Allah will make room for you﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:58:11:4-13}؟
x: The same verse promises that Allah raises by degrees those who believe and those given knowledge.
سُورَةُ المُجَادِلَةِ، الآيَةُ 11.

q: Surah Al-Ahqaf is named after the sand dunes where ﴾the brother of ʿAd﴿ warned his people. Who was he?
سُمِّيَتْ سُورَةُ الأَحْقَافِ بِالرِّمَالِ الَّتِي أَنْذَرَ عِنْدَهَا نَبِيٌّ قَوْمَهُ، وَجَاءَ ذِكْرُهُ فِيهَا: {Q:46:21:1-3}. فَمَنْ هُوَ؟
x: The brother of ʿAd is Hud {as}, as Allah says elsewhere: ﴾And to ʿAd, their brother Hud.﴿
أَخُو عَادٍ هُوَ هُودٌ {as}، كَمَا قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:7:65:1-4}.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾We have certainly created man in the best of stature﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:95:4}؟
x: The surah swears by the fig and the olive, then says man was made in the best form, yet can fall to the lowest of the low.
سُورَةُ التِّينِ، الآيَةُ 4.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾He created man from clay like pottery﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:55:14}؟
x: Man’s origin: dry clay that rings like pottery, fashioned by the Most Merciful.
سُورَةُ الرَّحْمَنِ، الآيَةُ 14.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾None touch it except the purified﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:56:79}؟
x: Said of the Quran itself: a noble Quran, in a well-protected Book.
سُورَةُ الوَاقِعَةِ، الآيَةُ 79.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾His command, when He wills a thing, is only to say to it “Be﴿, and it is”?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:36:82}؟
x: A single word is enough for Allah to bring anything into being. The surah ends: to Him you will be returned.
سُورَةُ يس، الآيَةُ 82.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾He utters no word except that beside him is a watcher, ready﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:50:18}؟
x: Not a single word a person says escapes being recorded.
سُورَةُ ق، الآيَةُ 18.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, We created everything in due measure﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:54:49}؟
x: Everything is created in exact measure, by Allah’s decree.
سُورَةُ القَمَرِ، الآيَةُ 49.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, I am Allah; there is no god except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:20:14}؟
x: Said at the very start of a prophet’s mission, it sums up the whole message: worship Allah alone.
سُورَةُ طه، الآيَةُ 14.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Those who pledge allegiance to you are pledging allegiance to Allah; the hand of Allah is over their hands﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:48:10:1-10}؟
x: The verse continues: ﴾the hand of Allah is over their hands﴿.
سُورَةُ الفَتْحِ، الآيَةُ 10.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Those who are humble in their prayer﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:23:2}؟
x: The surah opens: ﴾Successful indeed are the believers﴿, and humility in prayer is the first quality it lists.
سُورَةُ المُؤْمِنُونَ، الآيَةُ 2.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾They ask you about the soul. Say: the soul is from the affair of my Lord﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:17:85:1-8}؟
x: The verse ends: ﴾and you have not been given of knowledge except a little﴿.
سُورَةُ الإِسْرَاءِ، الآيَةُ 85.

q: Which surah begins ﴾The command of Allah is coming, so do not be impatient for it﴿?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي تَبْدَأُ بِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {Q:16:1:1-5}؟
x: Its opening tells those who demanded punishment not to be impatient: Allah’s command is certainly coming.
هِيَ سُورَةُ النَّحْلِ، السُّورَةُ رَقْمُ 16 فِي المُصْحَفِ.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾The servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth humbly﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:25:63:1-7}؟
x: They walk humbly, and when the ignorant address them, they reply with words of peace.
سُورَةُ الفُرْقَانِ، الآيَةُ 63.

q: The longest verse in the Quran is about what?
عَنْ أَيِّ مَوْضُوعٍ تَتَحَدَّثُ أَطْوَلُ آيَةٍ فِي القُرْآنِ؟
x: Verse 282 of Al-Baqarah sets out how to record a debt, and is known as the Verse of Debt.
الآيَةُ 282 مِنْ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، وَتُعْرَفُ بِآيَةِ الدَّيْنِ.

q: Surah 29 is named after which creature?
بِاسْمِ أَيِّ مَخْلُوقٍ سُمِّيَتِ السُّورَةُ التَّاسِعَةُ وَالعِشْرُونَ؟
x: Surah Al-ʿAnkabut compares those who take protectors other than Allah to the frail house of a spider.
سُورَةُ العَنْكَبُوتِ، وَفِيهَا تَشْبِيهُ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ أَوْلِيَاءَ بِبَيْتِ العَنْكَبُوتِ الوَاهِنِ.

q: Complete the verse from Surah Al-Kahf about the People of the Cave: ﴾And they remained in their cave three hundred years, and added…﴿
أَكْمِلِ الآيَةَ مِنْ سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ: {Q:18:25:1-7} ...
x: The People of the Cave slept for three hundred years, and nine more. Allah knows best how long they stayed.

q: Over roughly how many years was the Quran revealed?
فِي كَمْ سَنَةً تَقْرِيبًا نَزَلَ القُرْآنُ؟
x: Revelation came gradually across his whole prophethood, in Makkah and then Madinah.
بَدَأَ الوَحْيُ وَهُوَ {saw} ابْنُ أَرْبَعِينَ، ثُمَّ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً فِي مَكَّةَ وَعَشْرٌ فِي المَدِينَةِ، كَمَا رَوَى ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ {ra}.

q: Which surah names Abu Lahab and condemns him?
مَا السُّورَةُ الَّتِي ذَكَرَتْ أَبَا لَهَبٍ بِاسْمِهِ؟
x: It opens: ﴾May the hands of Abu Lahab perish, and perish he has.﴿
تَبْدَأُ بِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى: {Q:111:1}.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Of His signs is that He created for you spouses from yourselves, and placed between you affection and mercy﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:30:21:1-14}؟
x: The verse continues: He placed between spouses affection and mercy. In that are signs for people who reflect.
سُورَةُ الرُّومِ، الآيَةُ 21.

q: In Surah Al-Baqarah, a man passed by a ruined town and wondered how Allah would bring it back to life. How long did Allah cause him to die?
فِي سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَى قَرْيَةٍ خَاوِيَةٍ، فَأَمَاتَهُ اللَّهُ ثُمَّ بَعَثَهُ. كَمْ لَبِثَ؟
o: A day or part of a day
x: He thought he had stayed a day or part of a day, but Allah told him he had remained a hundred years.

q: The People of the Ditch (al-Ukhdud) are mentioned in which surah?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:85:4}؟
x: Surah Al-Buruj tells of those who were punished for burning the believers in a ditch.
ذَكَرَتْ سُورَةُ البُرُوجِ أَصْحَابَ الأُخْدُودِ الَّذِينَ فَتَنُوا المُؤْمِنِينَ.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Let them pardon and overlook. Would you not love that Allah should forgive you?﴿?
x: The verse urges those with means not to cut off their help to relatives and the needy, even after being wronged.
سُورَةُ النُّورِ، الآيَةُ 22.

q: Which surah records a father’s advice to his son: ﴾O my son, do not associate anything with Allah﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَتْ وَصِيَّةُ أَبٍ لِابْنِهِ: {Q:31:13:7-10}؟
x: Luqman told his son that associating others with Allah is a great wrong.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾O children of Adam, take your adornment at every masjid, and eat and drink but do not be excessive﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:7:31:1-11}؟
x: The verse continues: eat and drink, but do not waste; Allah does not like the wasteful.
سُورَةُ الأَعْرَافِ، الآيَةُ 31.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Then glorify the praise of your Lord and seek His forgiveness; indeed He is ever accepting of repentance﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:110:3}؟
x: Revealed when Allah’s help and victory came, it ends: glorify your Lord and seek His forgiveness, for He is ever accepting of repentance.
سُورَةُ النَّصْرِ، الآيَةُ 3.

q: ﴾Iram, of the lofty pillars﴿ is mentioned in which surah?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ ذُكِرَتْ {Q:89:7}؟
x: The surah recalls ʿAd, Thamud who carved rocks in the valley, and Firʿawn: all overstepped, and all were brought low.
ذَكَرَتْ سُورَةُ الفَجْرِ عَادًا وَإِرَمَ ذَاتَ العِمَادِ.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:29:45:9-14}؟
x: The verse adds: and the remembrance of Allah is greater still.
فِي سُورَةِ العَنْكَبُوتِ، الآيَةُ 45.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:21:107}؟
x: Every people had its prophet, but this verse describes the Prophet {saw} as a mercy for all the worlds.
فِي سُورَةِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، الآيَةُ 107.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of Allah is the most righteous of you﴿?
x: The verse says people were made into nations and tribes so they may know one another, and nobility is measured by mindfulness of Allah.
فِي سُورَةِ الحُجُرَاتِ، الآيَةُ 13.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾And your Lord has decreed that you worship none but Him, and be good to parents﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:17:23:1-8}؟
x: The verse continues: do not even say “uff” to your parents, nor scold them, but speak to them honourably.
فِي سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ، الآيَةُ 23.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾O you who believe, fasting has been prescribed for you﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:2:183:1-6}؟
x: Fasting was prescribed for the believers as it was for those before them, so that they may become mindful of Allah.
فِي سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، الآيَةُ 183.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾There is no compulsion in religion﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:2:256:1-4}؟
x: The verse explains why: the right way has become clearly distinct from error.
فِي سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، الآيَةُ 256.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Indeed, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:13:28:7-11}؟
x: The verse describes those who believe and whose hearts are reassured by the remembrance of Allah.
فِي سُورَةِ الرَّعْدِ، الآيَةُ 28.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾And whoever is mindful of Allah, He will make a way out for him﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:65:2:25-30}؟
x: The next verse adds: and He will provide for him from where he does not expect.
فِي سُورَةِ الطَّلَاقِ، الآيَةُ 2.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Your Lord has said: Call upon Me; I will respond to you﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:40:60:1-5}؟
x: The verse ends with a warning: those too proud to worship Me will enter Hell, humbled.
فِي سُورَةِ غَافِرٍ، الآيَةُ 60.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾And indeed, you are of a great moral character﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:68:4}؟
x: Said to the Prophet {saw} in a surah that opens with an oath by the pen and what is written.
فِي سُورَةِ القَلَمِ، الآيَةُ 4.

q: In which surah does Allah say: ﴾Say: O My servants who have transgressed against themselves, do not despair of the mercy of Allah﴿?
فِي أَيِّ سُورَةٍ جَاءَ قَوْلُهُ تَعَالَى: {Q:39:53:1-11}؟
x: The verse continues: do not despair of Allah’s mercy, for Allah forgives all sins.
فِي سُورَةِ الزُّمَرِ، الآيَةُ 53.

q: Surah Al-Hujurat likens backbiting to what?
بِمَاذَا شَبَّهَتْ سُورَةُ الحُجُرَاتِ الغِيبَةَ؟
o: Eating the flesh of one’s dead brother
x: The same verse forbids spying and much suspicion, then asks whether anyone would like to eat his dead brother’s flesh: ﴾you would hate it﴿.

q: Complete: ﴾Allah does not burden a soul beyond…﴿
x: This is the final verse of Al-Baqarah, which ends with the duʿas beginning “Our Lord”.

q: How many times does ﴾So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?﴿ appear in Surah Ar-Rahman?
كَمْ مَرَّةً تَكَرَّرَتْ {Q:55:13} فِي سُورَةِ الرَّحْمَنِ؟
x: After each blessing the surah mentions, from the sun and moon to the gardens of Paradise, the refrain asks the listener again.
تَكَرَّرَتْ هَذِهِ الآيَةُ فِي السُّورَةِ 31 مَرَّةً.

q: Which surah says twice, one verse after the other, ﴾Indeed, with hardship comes ease﴿?
x: Said twice, one verse after the other, as if to underline the promise. The surah also comforts the Prophet {saw} with a raised mention.
الآيَتَانِ 5 وَ6 مِنْ سُورَةِ الشَّرْحِ.

q: Complete: ﴾Indeed, Allah will not change the condition of a people until they change…﴿
x: A people’s condition changes only when they change themselves. The verse puts the responsibility on people too.

q: How many times does ﴾And We have certainly made the Quran easy for remembrance﴿ appear in Surah Al-Qamar?
كَمْ مَرَّةً تَكَرَّرَتْ {Q:54:17:1-4} فِي سُورَةِ القَمَرِ؟
x: The surah retells the fates of past nations, and after each one reminds us the Quran has been made easy to remember.
تَكَرَّرَتْ أَرْبَعَ مَرَّاتٍ فِي سُورَةِ القَمَرِ.

q: Complete: ﴾Every soul will taste…﴿
x: The verse continues: you will be paid your full reward only on the Day of Resurrection.

q: Allah says He is not shy to strike a parable of even which tiny creature, or anything above it?
يَقُولُ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ لَا يَسْتَحْيِي أَنْ يَضْرِبَ مَثَلًا مَا... فَمَا فَوْقَهَا. مَا هُوَ؟
x: Believers know such parables are the truth from their Lord, while those who disbelieve ask what Allah could possibly mean by them.

q: According to Surah Al-Hajj, those invoked besides Allah could never create even a…, even if they all gathered together for it.
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الحَجِّ، لَنْ يَخْلُقَ الَّذِينَ يُدْعَوْنَ مِنْ دُونِ اللَّهِ... وَلَوِ اجْتَمَعُوا لَهُ.
x: And if the fly snatched something away from them, they could not even take it back: ﴾Weak are the pursuer and the pursued.﴿

q: Surah Al-Jumuʿah likens those given the Tawrah who did not live by it to a donkey carrying…
شَبَّهَتْ سُورَةُ الجُمُعَةِ الَّذِينَ حُمِّلُوا التَّوْرَاةَ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَحْمِلُوهَا بِالحِمَارِ يَحْمِلُ...
x: The load it carries is precious, yet the donkey gains nothing from it.

q: In Surah Al-Baqarah, spending in Allah’s cause is like a grain that sprouts how many ears, each holding a hundred grains?
فِي سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَثَلُ الإِنْفَاقِ فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ حَبَّةٍ أَنْبَتَتْ كَمْ سُنْبُلَةً، فِي كُلِّ سُنْبُلَةٍ مِئَةُ حَبَّةٍ؟
x: One grain becomes seven hundred. The verse adds: ﴾and Allah multiplies for whom He wills﴿.

q: In the Verse of Light, Allah’s light is likened to a niche containing what?
فِي آيَةِ النُّورِ، مُثِّلَ نُورُ اللَّهِ بِمِشْكَاةٍ فِيهَا مَاذَا؟
x: The lamp is in a glass shining like a brilliant star, lit from a blessed olive tree: ﴾light upon light﴿.

q: Who was the first human Allah created?
مَنْ أَوَّلُ إِنْسَانٍ خَلَقَهُ اللَّهُ؟
x: Allah told the angels He would place a successor on earth, then created Adam {as} and taught him the names of all things. He commanded the angels to prostrate to Adam, and all did, except Iblis.
أَخْبَرَ اللَّهُ المَلَائِكَةَ أَنَّهُ جَاعِلٌ فِي الأَرْضِ خَلِيفَةً، وَخَلَقَ آدَمَ {as} وَعَلَّمَهُ الأَسْمَاءَ كُلَّهَا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {Q:2:34:1-10}.

q: Which prophet built the Ark?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ صَنَعَ السَّفِينَةَ؟
x: Allah told Nuh {as} to build the Ark under His watch and by His revelation. Every time a group of his people passed by, they mocked him.

q: Which prophet was swallowed by a great fish?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ الْتَقَمَهُ الحُوتُ؟
x: In the darkness inside the fish, Yunus {as} called out: ﴾There is no god but You, glory be to You; I was among the wrongdoers.﴿ Allah answered him and saved him from his distress.
نَادَى يُونُسُ {as} فِي الظُّلُمَاتِ: {Q:21:87:15-23}، فَاسْتَجَابَ اللَّهُ لَهُ وَنَجَّاهُ مِنَ الغَمِّ.

q: Who is the final prophet?
مَنْ خَاتَمُ الأَنْبِيَاءِ؟
x: The Quran says Muhammad {saw} is the Messenger of Allah and ﴾the Seal of the Prophets﴿: the last in the line of prophets.

q: Which prophet raised the foundations of the Kaʿbah with his son?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ رَفَعَ قَوَاعِدَ الكَعْبَةِ مَعَ ابْنِهِ؟
x: Ibrahim and his son Ismaʿil {as2} raised the foundations of the House together, praying: ﴾Our Lord, accept this from us.﴿
رَفَعَ إِبْرَاهِيمُ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ {as2} القَوَاعِدَ مِنَ البَيْتِ وَهُمَا يَدْعُوَانِ: {Q:2:127:8-10}.

q: Which prophet struck the sea with his staff so that it parted?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ ضَرَبَ البَحْرَ بِعَصَاهُ فَانْفَلَقَ؟
x: Allah told Musa {as} to strike the sea with his staff, and it split in two, each side like a great mountain. Musa’s people crossed safely, and Firʿawn’s army that followed was drowned.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:26:63}، فَأَنْجَى اللَّهُ مُوسَى وَمَنْ مَعَهُ، وَأَغْرَقَ فِرْعَوْنَ وَجُنْدَهُ.

q: Who was the mother of ʿIsa {as}?
مَنْ أُمُّ عِيسَى {as}؟
x: ʿIsa {as} is called “the son of Maryam” throughout the Quran, and a whole surah carries her name.
يُسَمَّى عِيسَى {as} فِي القُرْآنِ {Q:19:34:3-4}، وَمَرْيَمُ هِيَ المَرْأَةُ الوَحِيدَةُ المَذْكُورَةُ بِاسْمِهَا فِي القُرْآنِ، وَسُمِّيَتْ بِاسْمِهَا سُورَةٌ كَامِلَةٌ.

q: Which prophet did his brothers throw into the bottom of a well?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أَلْقَاهُ إِخْوَتُهُ فِي غَيَابَةِ الجُبِّ؟
x: His brothers were jealous because their father loved Yusuf more. Years later, Yusuf rose to high office in Egypt, and those same brothers came to him for food.
حَسَدَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ أَخَاهُمْ لِأَنَّ أَبَاهُمْ كَانَ يُحِبُّهُ أَكْثَرَ، ثُمَّ صَارَ يُوسُفُ عَلَى خَزَائِنِ مِصْرَ، وَجَاءَهُ إِخْوَتُهُ يَطْلُبُونَ الطَّعَامَ: {Q:12:58}.

q: Which prophet was given the Injil?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الإِنْجِيلَ؟
x: Allah gave ʿIsa {as} the Injil, containing guidance and light, confirming the Tawrah that came before it.

q: Which prophet did Allah take as a close friend (khalil)?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ اتَّخَذَهُ اللَّهُ خَلِيلًا؟
x: Allah took Ibrahim {as} as His close friend (khalil). The same verse praises following ﴾the way of Ibrahim, inclining to truth.﴿

q: ʿIsa {as} was born to Maryam without a father.
وُلِدَ عِيسَى {as} مِنْ مَرْيَمَ مِنْ غَيْرِ أَبٍ.
x: True. Maryam asked how she could have a son when no man had touched her. Allah compares ʿIsa to Adam: He said to him ﴾Be﴿, and he was.

q: Which prophet’s people were overtaken by the flood?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أَخَذَ الطُّوفَانُ قَوْمَهُ؟
x: Nuh {as} called his people to Allah for a very long time, yet only a few believed with him. Then the flood overtook those who did wrong.
دَعَا نُوحٌ {as} قَوْمَهُ زَمَنًا طَوِيلًا: {Q:11:40:22-26}، ثُمَّ أَخَذَهُمُ الطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَالِمُونَ.

q: Which prophet was sent to Firʿawn?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أُرْسِلَ إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ؟
x: Allah sent Musa {as} to Firʿawn with a surprising instruction: ﴾Speak to him gently, that perhaps he may remember or fear.﴿
أَرْسَلَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى {as} إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ، وَقَالَ: {Q:20:44}.

q: Which prophet was Musa’s brother, also made a prophet?
مَنْ أَخُو مُوسَى الَّذِي جَعَلَهُ اللَّهُ نَبِيًّا؟
x: Allah granted Musa {as} his brother Harun as a prophet, out of His mercy, and sent the two of them together to Firʿawn.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:19:53}، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَهُمَا مَعًا إِلَى فِرْعَوْنَ.

q: Which prophet inherited from Dawud {as}?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ وَرِثَ دَاوُدَ {as}؟
x: Sulayman {as} inherited from his father Dawud, and said: ﴾O people, we have been given from everything. Indeed, this is the evident bounty.﴿

q: Zakariyya {as} was given glad tidings of a son. What was his name?
بُشِّرَ زَكَرِيَّا {as} بِغُلَامٍ، فَمَا اسْمُهُ؟
x: In old age, Zakariyya {as} prayed for an heir. Allah answered with glad tidings of a son named Yahya, a name given to no one before him.
دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا {as} رَبَّهُ عَلَى كِبَرِ سِنِّهِ أَنْ يَهَبَهُ وَلِيًّا، فَبَشَّرَهُ اللَّهُ: {Q:19:7}.

q: In his old age, Allah granted Ibrahim {as} two sons. Who were they?
وَهَبَ اللَّهُ لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ {as} عَلَى الكِبَرِ وَلَدَيْنِ، فَمَنْ هُمَا؟
x: Ibrahim {as} thanked Allah: ﴾Praise be to Allah, who granted me in old age Ismaʿil and Ishaq. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.﴿

q: According to the Quran, what happened to ʿIsa {as}?
مَاذَا حَدَثَ لِعِيسَى {as} كَمَا جَاءَ فِي القُرْآنِ؟
o: Allah raised him up to Himself
x: The Quran says they did not kill him or crucify him; it was only made to appear so to them. Rather, Allah raised him up to Himself.

q: Which prophet’s hand came out shining white, without harm, as a sign?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ خَرَجَتْ يَدُهُ بَيْضَاءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوءٍ آيَةً؟
x: At the valley of Tuwa, Allah gave Musa {as} two signs: his staff became a moving snake, and his hand came out shining white, without any harm.
آتَى اللَّهُ مُوسَى {as} آيَتَيْنِ: العَصَا الَّتِي صَارَتْ حَيَّةً تَسْعَى، وَاليَدَ الَّتِي خَرَجَتْ بَيْضَاءَ: {Q:20:22}.

q: Which prophet was taught the speech of birds?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ عُلِّمَ مَنْطِقَ الطَّيْرِ؟
x: Sulayman {as} said: ﴾We have been taught the speech of birds.﴿ Allah gathered for him armies of jinn, people and birds, marching in orderly ranks.

q: Allah told the angels He would create a human being from clay.
أَخْبَرَ اللَّهُ المَلَائِكَةَ أَنَّهُ خَالِقٌ بَشَرًا مِنْ طِينٍ.
x: True. Allah told the angels He would create a human from clay: ﴾When I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down to him in prostration.﴿

q: As a baby, which prophet was taken into the house of Firʿawn?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ رُبِّيَ رَضِيعًا فِي بَيْتِ فِرْعَوْنَ؟
x: Allah inspired Musa’s mother to place him in the river, and Firʿawn’s family picked him up. Later Allah returned him to his mother, so that she would be comforted and not grieve.
أَوْحَى اللَّهُ إِلَى أُمِّ مُوسَى أَنْ تُلْقِيَهُ فِي اليَمِّ، فَالْتَقَطَهُ آلُ فِرْعَوْنَ، ثُمَّ رَدَّهُ إِلَيْهَا: {Q:28:13:1-8}.

q: Which prophet does the Quran describe as ﴾true to his promise﴿?
x: Allah says of Ismaʿil {as}: he was true to his promise, and a messenger and prophet. He used to command his family to pray and give zakah, and his Lord was pleased with him.

q: Which prophet was thrown into a fire that Allah made cool and safe?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أُلْقِيَ فِي النَّارِ فَجَعَلَهَا اللَّهُ بَرْدًا وَسَلَامًا؟
x: His people decided to burn him, but Allah said: ﴾O fire, be coolness and safety upon Ibrahim﴿.

q: Which prophet spoke as a baby in the cradle?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ تَكَلَّمَ فِي المَهْدِ؟
x: ʿIsa {as} spoke from the cradle in defence of his mother Maryam, declaring that he was a servant of Allah.
تَكَلَّمَ عِيسَى {as} فِي المَهْدِ مُبَرِّئًا أُمَّهُ مَرْيَمَ: {Q:19:30:1-4}.

q: Which prophet was given the Zabur (Psalms)?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أُوتِيَ الزَّبُورَ؟
x: The Zabur is one of the revealed scriptures, alongside the Tawrah, the Injil and the Quran.

q: Which prophet interpreted the king’s dream of seven fat and seven lean cows?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ فَسَّرَ رُؤْيَا المَلِكِ عَنْ سَبْعِ بَقَرَاتٍ سِمَانٍ وَسَبْعٍ عِجَافٍ؟
x: Yusuf {as} explained it as seven years of plenty followed by seven years of hardship.
فَسَّرَهَا يُوسُفُ {as} بِسَبْعِ سِنِينَ خِصْبٍ تَتْبَعُهَا سَبْعٌ شِدَادٌ.

q: Which prophet heard an ant warn its colony to take cover?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ سَمِعَ نَمْلَةً تُحَذِّرُ قَوْمَهَا؟
x: The ant told the others to go into their homes so Sulayman’s army would not crush them without noticing. He smiled at her words and thanked Allah.
تَبَسَّمَ سُلَيْمَانُ {as} ضَاحِكًا مِنْ قَوْلِهَا وَشَكَرَ نِعْمَةَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ.

q: Who was the father of Yusuf {as}?
مَنْ وَالِدُ يُوسُفَ {as}؟
x: Yusuf {as} named his forefathers: Ibrahim, Ishaq and Yaʿqub.
ذَكَرَ يُوسُفُ {as} آبَاءَهُ: إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْحَاقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ.

q: As a baby, which prophet was placed by his mother in a chest and cast into the river?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ وَضَعَتْهُ أُمُّهُ وَهُوَ رَضِيعٌ فِي تَابُوتٍ وَأَلْقَتْهُ فِي اليَمِّ؟
x: Allah inspired Musa’s mother to put him in a chest and cast it into the river.

q: To which prophet did Allah speak directly?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ كَلَّمَهُ اللَّهُ تَكْلِيمًا؟
x: The Quran stresses it: ﴾and Allah spoke to Musa with direct speech﴿.

q: Which prophet asked Allah to show him how He gives life to the dead, and was told to take four birds?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ أَنْ يُرِيَهُ كَيْفَ يُحْيِي المَوْتَى، فَأُمِرَ أَنْ يَأْخُذَ أَرْبَعَةً مِنَ الطَّيْرِ؟
x: Ibrahim {as} asked so that his heart would be at rest, and Allah told him to take four birds.

q: Which prophet’s son refused to board the Ark, saying he would take refuge on a mountain?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أَبَى ابْنُهُ أَنْ يَرْكَبَ مَعَهُ السَّفِينَةَ وَقَالَ سَآوِي إِلَى جَبَلٍ؟
x: Nuh {as} called his son to board, and he answered that a mountain would protect him from the water.

q: Which prophet was put in prison even after the signs of his innocence were clear?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ سُجِنَ بَعْدَ أَنْ ظَهَرَتْ آيَاتُ بَرَاءَتِهِ؟
x: After they had seen the signs, it seemed best to them to imprison him for a time.

q: Whose wife prayed: ﴾My Lord, build for me a house near You in Paradise﴿?
x: Her husband claimed to be a god, yet she believed and asked Allah to save her from Firʿawn and his deeds.

q: Along with the wife of Lut, whose wife does the Quran give as an example for those who disbelieve?
مَعَ امْرَأَةِ لُوطٍ، امْرَأَةُ مَنْ ضَرَبَهَا اللَّهُ مَثَلًا لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا؟
x: Being married to prophets did not save them: they were told, enter the Fire with those who enter.

q: By Allah’s permission, what did ʿIsa {as} do with birds shaped from clay?
بِإِذْنِ اللَّهِ، مَاذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ عِيسَى {as} بِالطِّينِ عَلَى هَيْئَةِ الطَّيْرِ؟
o: Breathed into them and they became birds
x: He shaped them from clay, breathed into them, and they became birds by Allah’s permission.

q: Who said ﴾We are the helpers of Allah﴿ when ʿIsa {as} asked who would support him?
مَنْ قَالُوا {Q:3:52:13-15} حِينَ سَأَلَ عِيسَى {as} عَنْ أَنْصَارِهِ؟
x: The disciples answered: we believe in Allah; bear witness that we are Muslims.

q: The disciples asked ʿIsa {as} whether his Lord could send down what from the sky?
مَاذَا طَلَبَ الحَوَارِيُّونَ مِنْ عِيسَى {as} أَنْ يُنَزِّلَهُ رَبُّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ؟
x: They wanted to eat from it and have their hearts reassured. ʿIsa {as} prayed, and Allah answered that He would send it down. The surah is named after it: Al-Maʾidah, “the Table Spread”.

q: At the sacred valley of Tuwa, what was Musa {as} told to remove?
فِي الوَادِي المُقَدَّسِ طُوًى، مَاذَا أُمِرَ مُوسَى {as} أَنْ يَخْلَعَ؟
x: ﴾Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals; you are in the sacred valley of Tuwa.﴿

q: Which prophet saw in a dream that he was sacrificing his son?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ رَأَى فِي المَنَامِ أَنَّهُ يَذْبَحُ ابْنَهُ؟
x: His son answered: O my father, do as you are commanded; you will find me, if Allah wills, among the patient.

q: With what did Allah ransom the son of Ibrahim {as}?
بِمَاذَا فَدَى اللَّهُ ابْنَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ {as}؟
x: Father and son both submitted to Allah’s command. Allah called out that Ibrahim had fulfilled the vision, and ransomed the son with a great sacrifice.

q: What did Yusuf’s brothers claim had eaten him?
مَاذَا زَعَمَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ أَنَّهُ أَكَلَهُ؟
x: They said they had left him with their belongings and a wolf ate him.

q: The town of which prophet’s people was turned upside down and rained with stones of baked clay?
قَرْيَةُ قَوْمِ أَيِّ نَبِيٍّ جُعِلَ عَالِيهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأُمْطِرَتْ حِجَارَةً مِنْ سِجِّيلٍ؟
x: The angels came to Lut {as} as guests. By morning, the town was overturned and rained upon with stones of baked clay.

q: Which prophet saw a fire and told his family ﴾Stay here, I have seen a fire﴿?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ رَأَى نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ {Q:20:10:6-9}؟
x: He hoped to bring back a burning brand or find guidance at the fire.

q: Which prophet was sent to the people of ʿAd?
مَنِ النَّبِيُّ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَى قَوْمِ عَادٍ؟
x: Hud {as} was sent to ʿAd, a mighty people who built monuments on every high place.

q: Which prophet’s people were given a she-camel as a sign?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ كَانَتِ النَّاقَةُ آيَةً لِقَوْمِهِ؟
x: Salih {as} was sent to Thamud, and the she-camel of Allah was a clear sign to them.
أُرْسِلَ صَالِحٌ {as} إِلَى ثَمُودَ، وَكَانَتْ نَاقَةُ اللَّهِ لَهُمْ آيَةً.

q: Which prophet was sent to the people of Madyan?
مَنِ النَّبِيُّ الَّذِي أُرْسِلَ إِلَى أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ؟
x: Shuʿayb {as} called them to worship Allah alone and to give full measure and weight.
دَعَاهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ {as} إِلَى عِبَادَةِ اللَّهِ وَحْدَهُ وَإِيفَاءِ الكَيْلِ وَالمِيزَانِ.

q: Which prophet does the Quran praise for patience through illness and loss?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أَثْنَى اللَّهُ عَلَى صَبْرِهِ فِي المَرَضِ وَالبَلَاءِ؟
x: When he called out to his Lord, Allah told him to strike the ground with his foot, and a cool spring came forth to wash in and drink.

q: Which prophet was given glad tidings, in old age, of a son named Yahya?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ بُشِّرَ عَلَى كِبَرِ سِنِّهِ بِغُلَامٍ اسْمُهُ يَحْيَى؟
x: Zakariyya {as} called on his Lord in private for an heir, and Allah granted him Yahya.
نَادَى زَكَرِيَّا {as} رَبَّهُ نِدَاءً خَفِيًّا، فَبَشَّرَهُ اللَّهُ بِيَحْيَى.

q: What did Musa’s staff become when he threw it before Firʿawn?
مَاذَا صَارَتْ عَصَا مُوسَى حِينَ أَلْقَاهَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْ فِرْعَوْنَ؟
x: ﴾So he threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent, plain to see.﴿

q: Dawud and Sulayman {as2} judged the case of sheep that grazed in a field at night. To whom did Allah give the understanding of it?
حَكَمَ دَاوُدُ وَسُلَيْمَانُ {as2} فِي الحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ القَوْمِ، فَلِمَنْ فَهَّمَ اللَّهُ الحُكْمَ؟
x: Allah made Sulayman understand it, and gave each of them judgment and knowledge.

q: Which prophet broke his people’s idols into pieces, except the biggest one?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ جَعَلَ أَصْنَامَ قَوْمِهِ جُذَاذًا إِلَّا كَبِيرًا لَهُمْ؟
x: When they asked who had done it, he told them to ask the idols themselves, if they could speak.

q: The Queen of Sheba said, ﴾I submit, with Sulayman, to Allah, Lord of the worlds.﴿ What did she mistake his glass floor for?
قَالَتْ مَلِكَةُ سَبَأٍ: {Q:27:44:23-28}. بِمَاذَا ظَنَّتْ صَرْحَ سُلَيْمَانَ حِينَ رَأَتْهُ؟
x: When she saw it she thought it was a pool of water, and uncovered her shins; he told her it was a palace paved with glass.

q: While Musa {as} was away, who led his people astray into worshipping a calf?
مَنْ أَضَلَّ قَوْمَ مُوسَى {as} فِي غِيَابِهِ فَعَبَدُوا العِجْلَ؟
x: Allah told Musa that his people had been tested after he left, and that as-Samiri led them astray.

q: Which prophet was sold for a small price of a few dirhams?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ بِيعَ بِثَمَنٍ بَخْسٍ دَرَاهِمَ مَعْدُودَةٍ؟
x: The travellers who found Yusuf sold him for a small price, a few dirhams.

q: Firʿawn ordered his minister to build a tower so he could look for the God of Musa. Who was the minister?
أَمَرَ فِرْعَوْنُ وَزِيرَهُ أَنْ يَبْنِيَ لَهُ صَرْحًا لِيَطَّلِعَ إِلَى إِلَهِ مُوسَى، فَمَنِ الوَزِيرُ؟
x: Firʿawn said: O Haman, kindle a fire upon the clay and make for me a tower.

q: Which rich man from the people of Musa was swallowed by the earth with his home?
مَنِ الرَّجُلُ الغَنِيُّ مِنْ قَوْمِ مُوسَى الَّذِي خُسِفَ بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الأَرْضُ؟
x: His treasure keys were heavy for a group of strong men, yet the earth swallowed him.

q: For which prophet did Allah make iron soft?
لِأَيِّ نَبِيٍّ أَلَانَ اللَّهُ الحَدِيدَ؟
x: Iron became soft in his hands: a sign of Allah’s favour to Dawud {as}.

q: Some of the jinn worked in front of which prophet, by his Lord’s permission?
لِأَيِّ نَبِيٍّ كَانَ مِنَ الجِنِّ مَنْ يَعْمَلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ بِإِذْنِ رَبِّهِ؟
x: Allah gave Sulayman {as} powers no one else had, as a gift and a test of gratitude.

q: Which bird was missing when Sulayman {as} inspected the birds, and came back with news of Sheba?
مَا الطَّائِرُ الَّذِي غَابَ حِينَ تَفَقَّدَ سُلَيْمَانُ {as} الطَّيْرَ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ بِنَبَأِ سَبَأٍ؟
x: The hoopoe said: I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

q: How did the jinn come to know that Sulayman {as} had died?
كَيْفَ عَرَفَ الجِنُّ بِمَوْتِ سُلَيْمَانَ {as}؟
o: A creature of the earth ate his staff and he fell
x: When he fell, the jinn realised that had they known the unseen, they would not have stayed in humiliating labour.

q: With which prophet did the mountains and birds echo Allah’s praise?
مَعَ أَيِّ نَبِيٍّ أَوَّبَتِ الجِبَالُ وَالطَّيْرُ بِالتَّسْبِيحِ؟
x: Allah describes Dawud {as} as a man of strength who constantly turned back to Him.

q: Which prophet said, as he left his people, ﴾I am going to my Lord; He will guide me﴿?
x: After his people tried to burn him, Ibrahim {as} set out towards his Lord.

q: Which prophet was given glad tidings of ﴾a forbearing boy﴿?
x: This came right after Ibrahim prayed for a righteous child.

q: Who killed Jalut (Goliath)?
مَنْ قَتَلَ جَالُوتَ؟
x: Dawud killed Jalut, and Allah gave him kingship and wisdom. The verse adds that if Allah did not check some people by means of others, the earth would be corrupted.

q: Whom did Allah appoint as king over the Children of Israel before the battle with Jalut?
مَنْ بَعَثَهُ اللَّهُ مَلِكًا عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ قَبْلَ قِتَالِ جَالُوتَ؟
x: Their prophet told them Allah had appointed Talut as king, increasing him in knowledge and stature.

q: Of which prophet does Allah say ﴾We raised him to a high place﴿?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ قَالَ اللَّهُ فِيهِ: {Q:19:57}؟
x: Allah describes Idris {as} as a man of truth and a prophet, and says He raised him to a high place.
وَصَفَ اللَّهُ إِدْرِيسَ {as} بِأَنَّهُ كَانَ صِدِّيقًا نَبِيًّا.

q: What did Yusuf’s brothers bring their father to convince him a wolf had eaten Yusuf?
بِمَاذَا جَاءَ إِخْوَةُ يُوسُفَ أَبَاهُمْ لِيُوهِمُوهُ أَنَّ الذِّئْبَ أَكَلَهُ؟
x: Yaʿqub {as} answered that their souls had enticed them, and that patience is most fitting.

q: The wind was made to serve which prophet?
لِأَيِّ نَبِيٍّ سَخَّرَ اللَّهُ الرِّيحَ؟
x: The wind carried his journey a month’s travel in a morning, and a month’s travel in an evening.

q: Yunus {as} was sent to how many people?
إِلَى كَمْ أُرْسِلَ يُونُسُ {as}؟
x: Allah sent him to a hundred thousand or more. They believed, and Allah gave them enjoyment of life for a time.

q: In his dream, how many stars did Yusuf {as} see bowing to him, along with the sun and the moon?
كَمْ كَوْكَبًا رَأَى يُوسُفُ {as} فِي مَنَامِهِ سَاجِدِينَ لَهُ مَعَ الشَّمْسِ وَالقَمَرِ؟
x: Yusuf told his father he saw eleven stars, the sun and the moon bowing to him.

q: What name does the Quran give for the father of Ibrahim {as}?
مَا اسْمُ أَبِي إِبْرَاهِيمَ {as} كَمَا جَاءَ فِي القُرْآنِ؟
x: Allah says Ibrahim said to his father Azar: do you take idols as gods?

q: Whose wife laughed when the angels brought her glad tidings of Ishaq?
امْرَأَةُ أَيِّ نَبِيٍّ ضَحِكَتْ حِينَ بُشِّرَتْ بِإِسْحَاقَ؟
x: His wife was standing, and she laughed; then she was given glad tidings of Ishaq, and after him Yaʿqub.

q: Which prophet was given nine clear signs?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ تِسْعَ آيَاتٍ بَيِّنَاتٍ؟
x: Allah gave Musa nine clear signs, yet Firʿawn still called him bewitched.

q: Which prophet asked Allah for a kingdom that no one after him would have?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ مُلْكًا لَا يَنْبَغِي لِأَحَدٍ مِنْ بَعْدِهِ؟
x: Sulayman {as} asked forgiveness and a kingdom that would suit no one after him.

q: Which prophet is mentioned with Ismaʿil and Idris, all described as among the patient?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ ذُكِرَ مَعَ إِسْمَاعِيلَ وَإِدْرِيسَ، وَكُلٌّ مِنَ الصَّابِرِينَ؟
x: Allah admitted them all into His mercy; they were among the righteous.

q: Which prophet was given wisdom while still a child?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ آتَاهُ اللَّهُ الحُكْمَ صَبِيًّا؟
x: Allah told Yahya to hold the Book firmly, and gave him wisdom as a child.

q: How long did Nuh {as} remain among his people?
كَمْ لَبِثَ نُوحٌ {as} فِي قَوْمِهِ؟
x: He remained among his people a thousand years less fifty, and then the flood overtook them.

q: Which prophet was sent to the Companions of the Thicket (Ashab al-Aykah)?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أُرْسِلَ إِلَى أَصْحَابِ الأَيْكَةِ؟
x: The Companions of the Thicket denied the messengers when Shuʿayb said to them: will you not fear Allah?

q: When Musa {as} struck the rock with his staff, how many springs gushed out?
لَمَّا ضَرَبَ مُوسَى {as} الحَجَرَ بِعَصَاهُ، كَمْ عَيْنًا انْفَجَرَتْ مِنْهُ؟
x: Each tribe knew its own drinking place, and they were told: eat and drink from Allah’s provision, and do not spread corruption.

q: When the women saw Yusuf {as}, what did they do in their amazement?
لَمَّا رَأَتِ النِّسْوَةُ يُوسُفَ {as}، مَاذَا فَعَلْنَ مِنَ الدَّهْشَةِ؟
x: They said: this is no human; this is none but a noble angel.

q: What did Yusuf {as} ask the king to put him in charge of?
عَلَى مَاذَا طَلَبَ يُوسُفُ {as} مِنَ المَلِكِ أَنْ يَجْعَلَهُ؟
x: He said: “I am a knowing guardian.” He saw he could serve people through the lean years ahead.

q: What did Yusuf {as} place in his brother’s bag?
مَاذَا جَعَلَ يُوسُفُ {as} فِي رَحْلِ أَخِيهِ؟
x: It was a plan to keep his brother with him. Then a caller announced: O caravan, you are thieves.

q: What did Yusuf {as} send to be cast over his father’s face so that his sight would return?
مَاذَا أَرْسَلَ يُوسُفُ {as} لِيُلْقَى عَلَى وَجْهِ أَبِيهِ فَيَرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًا؟
x: ﴾Take this shirt of mine and cast it over my father’s face; he will regain his sight.﴿

q: Musa {as} said he would not stop until he reached what place?
إِلَى أَيْنَ قَالَ مُوسَى {as} إِنَّهُ لَنْ يَبْرَحَ حَتَّى يَبْلُغَهُ؟
o: The junction of the two seas
x: There he met a servant of Allah who had been given knowledge from Allah.

q: On the journey in Surah Al-Kahf, what did the righteous servant do to the boat?
فِي قِصَّةِ سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ، مَاذَا فَعَلَ العَبْدُ الصَّالِحُ بِالسَّفِينَةِ؟
x: Musa objected: have you made a hole in it to drown its people?

q: After a man warned Musa {as} that the chiefs were plotting to kill him, towards which land did he head?
بَعْدَ أَنْ حَذَّرَ رَجُلٌ مُوسَى {as} مِنْ أَنَّ المَلَأَ يَأْتَمِرُونَ بِهِ لِيَقْتُلُوهُ، إِلَى أَيِّ أَرْضٍ تَوَجَّهَ؟
x: He turned towards Madyan, hoping his Lord would guide him to the right way.

q: For how many years at minimum did the old man of Madyan ask Musa {as} to work, in return for marriage to his daughter?
كَمْ سَنَةً عَلَى الأَقَلِّ طَلَبَ شَيْخُ مَدْيَنَ مِنْ مُوسَى {as} أَنْ يَعْمَلَ لَهُ مُقَابِلَ زَوَاجِهِ مِنِ ابْنَتِهِ؟
x: Eight years, and if he completed ten, that would be his own choice. Musa agreed.

q: Where did the Ark of Nuh {as} come to rest?
عَلَى أَيِّ مَوْضِعٍ اسْتَوَتْ سَفِينَةُ نُوحٍ {as}؟
x: The earth swallowed its water, the sky withheld, and the Ark rested on al-Judi.

q: Which prophet said ﴾Indeed, I am ill﴿ when his people went out to their festival?
x: After they left for their festival, he turned to their idols.

q: Which prophet was saved with his family, except his wife, who remained behind?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ نَجَّاهُ اللَّهُ وَأَهْلَهُ إِلَّا امْرَأَتَهُ كَانَتْ مِنَ الغَابِرِينَ؟
x: His wife stayed behind with the wrongdoers and was destroyed with them.

q: Surah Al-Anʿam names a group of prophets together in verses 83 to 86. How many?
ذَكَرَتْ سُورَةُ الأَنْعَامِ فِي الآيَاتِ 83 إِلَى 86 جَمْعًا مِنَ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، فَكَمْ عَدَدُهُمْ؟
x: Ibrahim, then Ishaq, Yaʿqub, Nuh, Dawud, Sulayman, Ayyub, Yusuf, Musa, Harun, Zakariyya, Yahya, ʿIsa, Ilyas, Ismaʿil, Al-Yasaʿ, Yunus and Lut.

إِبْرَاهِيمُ، ثُمَّ إِسْحَاقُ وَيَعْقُوبُ وَنُوحٌ وَدَاوُدُ وَسُلَيْمَانُ وَأَيُّوبُ وَيُوسُفُ وَمُوسَى وَهَارُونُ وَزَكَرِيَّا وَيَحْيَى وَعِيسَى وَإِلْيَاسُ وَإِسْمَاعِيلُ وَاليَسَعُ وَيُونُسُ وَلُوطٌ.

q: Which prophet said: ﴾My Lord, I am in need of whatever good You send down to me﴿?
x: He said it after helping two women water their flocks, then sitting alone in the shade.
قَالَهَا مُوسَى {as} بَعْدَ أَنْ سَقَى لِلْمَرْأَتَيْنِ فِي مَدْيَنَ: {Q:28:24}.

q: Which prophet prayed: ﴾My Lord, do not leave me alone, and You are the best of inheritors﴿?
x: Allah answered him and granted him Yahya, curing his wife so she could bear a child.

q: Which prophet called out: ﴾Adversity has touched me, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful﴿?
x: Allah answered him, removed his affliction, and restored his family to him and the like of them with them.

q: Which prophet said: ﴾I only complain of my grief and sorrow to Allah﴿?
x: He said it while grieving, adding: I know from Allah what you do not know.
قَالَهَا يَعْقُوبُ {as} فِي حُزْنِهِ عَلَى يُوسُفَ: {Q:12:86}.

q: Which prophet said: ﴾My Lord, prison is dearer to me than what they invite me to﴿?
x: He preferred prison to disobeying Allah, and Allah answered his prayer and turned their plot away from him.

q: Who prayed: ﴾Our Lord, we have wronged ourselves, and if You do not forgive us and have mercy on us, we will surely be among the losers﴿?
x: They said it after eating from the tree, and Allah accepted their repentance.

q: Which prophet said to his father: ﴾O my father, do not worship Satan﴿?
x: He called his father gently, again and again, saying: I fear a punishment from the Most Merciful may touch you.

q: Which prophet prayed: ﴾My Lord, do not leave upon the earth any of the disbelievers as an inhabitant﴿?
x: Nuh {as} prayed after long centuries of calling his people, when Allah had told him none would believe beyond those who already had.

q: Which prophet asked his Lord to show him how He gives life to the dead ﴾so that my heart may be at rest﴿?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ سَأَلَ رَبَّهُ أَنْ يُرِيَهُ كَيْفَ يُحْيِي المَوْتَى وَقَالَ: {Q:2:260:14-16}؟
x: Ibrahim {as} said he believed, but wanted his heart to be at rest.

q: How many surahs are named after prophets?
كَمْ سُورَةً سُمِّيَتْ بِأَسْمَاءِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ؟
x: Yunus, Hud, Yusuf, Ibrahim, Muhammad and Nuh: six surahs carry the names of prophets.
يُونُسُ، وَهُودٌ، وَيُوسُفُ، وَإِبْرَاهِيمُ، وَمُحَمَّدٌ، وَنُوحٌ.

q: The Quran names Maryam as the daughter of whom?
ابْنَةَ مَنْ سَمَّى القُرْآنُ مَرْيَمَ؟
x: Allah praises her as one who guarded her chastity and believed in the words of her Lord and His Books.

q: In Surah Al-Qalam, how is Yunus {as} referred to?
بِمَاذَا وُصِفَ يُونُسُ {as} فِي سُورَةِ القَلَمِ؟
x: The Prophet {saw} is told to be patient and not be like the companion of the fish.

q: Which prophet’s people mocked him: ﴾Does your prayer command you that we leave what our fathers worshipped?﴿
x: His people mocked the idea that prayer should shape how they worship and how they trade.

q: Allah appointed thirty nights for Musa {as} and completed them with ten more. What was the total term?
وَاعَدَ اللَّهُ مُوسَى {as} ثَلَاثِينَ لَيْلَةً وَأَتَمَّهَا بِعَشْرٍ، فَكَمْ تَمَّ مِيقَاتُ رَبِّهِ؟
x: Musa left his brother in charge of his people while he went to the appointment.

q: In Surah Al ʿImran, for how many days would Zakariyya {as} not speak to people except by gestures, as a sign?
فِي سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، كَمْ يَوْمًا كَانَتْ آيَةُ زَكَرِيَّا {as} أَلَّا يُكَلِّمَ النَّاسَ إِلَّا رَمْزًا؟
x: His sign was that he would not speak to people for three days except by gestures.

q: How many men did Musa {as} choose from his people for the appointment with Allah?
كَمْ رَجُلًا اخْتَارَ مُوسَى {as} مِنْ قَوْمِهِ لِمِيقَاتِ رَبِّهِ؟
x: Seventy men went with him; when the earthquake seized them, Musa pleaded with his Lord.

q: For how many years did the people of Musa {as} wander in the land after refusing to enter it?
كَمْ سَنَةً تَاهَ قَوْمُ مُوسَى {as} فِي الأَرْضِ بَعْدَ أَنْ أَبَوْا دُخُولَهَا؟
x: The land was forbidden to them for forty years; they would wander in the earth.

q: After asking the freed prisoner to mention him to the king, how long did Yusuf {as} remain in prison?
بَعْدَ أَنْ قَالَ يُوسُفُ {as} لِلنَّاجِي {Q:12:42:7-9}، كَمْ لَبِثَ فِي السِّجْنِ؟
x: Satan made the man forget to mention him, so Yusuf remained in prison a few years.

q: In Surah Al-Kahf, what was the third act of the righteous servant that Musa {as} questioned?
فِي سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ، مَا الفِعْلُ الثَّالِثُ لِلْعَبْدِ الصَّالِحِ الَّذِي سَأَلَ عَنْهُ مُوسَى {as}؟
o: He rebuilt a wall about to collapse
He made a hole in a boat
x: After the boat and the boy, they found a wall about to collapse in a town that refused them hospitality, and he set it straight.

q: The Prophet {saw} was born in Madinah.
وُلِدَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} فِي المَدِينَةِ المُنَوَّرَةِ.
x: False. He was born and grew up in Makkah. Madinah became his home only after he emigrated there, and he is buried there.
خَطَأٌ. وُلِدَ فِي مَكَّةَ وَنَشَأَ فِيهَا، وَلَمْ تُصْبِحِ المَدِينَةُ دَارَهُ إِلَّا بَعْدَ هِجْرَتِهِ إِلَيْهَا، وَفِيهَا دُفِنَ.

q: Where did the first revelation come to the Prophet {saw}?
أَيْنَ نَزَلَ الوَحْيُ أَوَّلَ مَرَّةٍ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
x: Before revelation, he used to go to the Cave of Hiraʾ to worship alone for many nights. It was there that the angel came to him with the first verses of the Quran.
كَانَ {saw} يَخْلُو بِغَارِ حِرَاءٍ يَتَعَبَّدُ فِيهِ اللَّيَالِيَ ذَوَاتِ العَدَدِ، وَفِيهِ جَاءَهُ المَلَكُ بِأَوَّلِ مَا نَزَلَ مِنَ القُرْآنِ.

q: Which angel brought the revelation?
أَيُّ مَلَكٍ نَزَلَ بِالوَحْيِ؟
x: Allah says Jibril brought the Quran down upon the Prophet’s heart, by Allah’s permission. Elsewhere the Quran calls him ﴾the Trustworthy Spirit﴿.

q: What is the Prophet’s {saw} migration from Makkah to Madinah called?
بِمَاذَا يُعْرَفُ خُرُوجُ النَّبِيِّ {saw} مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى المَدِينَةِ؟
x: The Islamic calendar counts its years from the Hijrah, the Prophet’s migration from Makkah to Madinah. Dates in it are marked AH, “after the Hijrah”.
يَبْدَأُ التَّقْوِيمُ الهِجْرِيُّ مِنْ هِجْرَةِ النَّبِيِّ {saw} مِنْ مَكَّةَ إِلَى المَدِينَةِ، وَمِنْهَا سُمِّيَ هِجْرِيًّا.

q: Who was the Prophet’s {saw} first wife?
مَنْ أَوَّلُ زَوْجَاتِ النَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
x: When he came home shaken after the first revelation, Khadijah {raf} comforted him: Allah would never disgrace him, for he kept family ties and supported the weak.
لَمَّا رَجَعَ {saw} مِنْ غَارِ حِرَاءٍ يَرْجُفُ فُؤَادُهُ، طَمْأَنَتْهُ خَدِيجَةُ {raf} فَقَالَتْ: «كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ مَا يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ لَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ».

q: What is the Prophet’s {saw} mosque in Madinah called?
مَا اسْمُ مَسْجِدِ النَّبِيِّ {saw} فِي المَدِينَةِ؟
x: Building this mosque was one of the first things he did with his Companions after arriving in Madinah. It became the heart of the community: for prayer, learning and gathering.
كَانَ بِنَاؤُهُ مِنْ أَوَّلِ مَا قَامَ بِهِ {saw} مَعَ أَصْحَابِهِ بَعْدَ وُصُولِهِ إِلَى المَدِينَةِ، فَصَارَ قَلْبَ المُجْتَمَعِ: لِلصَّلَاةِ وَالتَّعَلُّمِ وَالاِجْتِمَاعِ.

q: How old was the Prophet {saw} when revelation began?
كَمْ كَانَ عُمُرُ النَّبِيِّ {saw} حِينَ بَدَأَ الوَحْيُ؟
x: Revelation came to him at forty, the age at which it began.
نَزَلَ عَلَيْهِ الوَحْيُ وَهُوَ ابْنُ أَرْبَعِينَ، وَكَانَتْ بِدَايَتُهُ فِي غَارِ حِرَاءٍ.

q: In the Cave of Hiraʾ, what was the angel’s first command to the Prophet {saw}?
فِي غَارِ حِرَاءٍ، بِمَاذَا أَمَرَ المَلَكُ النَّبِيَّ {saw} أَوَّلًا؟
x: The angel appeared to him in the cave and gave this single command. It was the very beginning of the Quran’s revelation.
جَاءَهُ المَلَكُ فِي الغَارِ فَقَالَ: «اقْرَأْ»، فَكَانَتْ بِدَايَةَ نُزُولِ القُرْآنِ.

q: When the angel said “Read!”, what did the Prophet {saw} reply?
لَمَّا قَالَ المَلَكُ «اقْرَأْ»، بِمَاذَا أَجَابَ النَّبِيُّ {saw}؟
x: He meant that he did not know how to read. The angel pressed him tightly and repeated the command, and then the first verses of the Quran were revealed.
قَالَ: «مَا أَنَا بِقَارِئٍ»، أَيْ لَا أُحْسِنُ القِرَاءَةَ، فَغَطَّهُ المَلَكُ وَكَرَّرَ الأَمْرَ، ثُمَّ نَزَلَتْ أُولَى آيَاتِ القُرْآنِ.

q: Since the qiblah was changed, Muslims turn in prayer towards which mosque?
بَعْدَ تَحْوِيلِ القِبْلَةِ، نَحْوَ أَيِّ مَسْجِدٍ يَتَوَجَّهُ المُسْلِمُونَ فِي صَلَاتِهِمْ؟
x: Allah commanded the Prophet {saw} to turn his face towards al-Masjid al-Haram, and told the believers: ﴾wherever you are, turn your faces towards it﴿.

q: During the Hijrah, which cave did the Prophet {saw} and Abu Bakr {ra} hide in?
فِي الهِجْرَةِ، فِي أَيِّ غَارٍ اخْتَبَأَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} وَأَبُو بَكْرٍ {ra}؟
x: They hid in the Cave of Thawr, south of Makkah, for several days while Quraysh searched for them.
اخْتَبَآ فِي غَارِ ثَوْرٍ جَنُوبَ مَكَّةَ أَيَّامًا وَقُرَيْشٌ تَطْلُبُهُمَا.

q: Which city was the Prophet {saw} and his Companions based in, whose people the Quran says should not hold back from him?
مَا المَدِينَةُ الَّتِي قَالَ القُرْآنُ إِنَّهُ مَا كَانَ لِأَهْلِهَا أَنْ يَتَخَلَّفُوا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ {saw}؟
x: Surah At-Tawbah names the people of Madinah.

q: Surah Al-Ahzab says that in the Messenger of Allah {saw} you have…
تَقُولُ سُورَةُ الأَحْزَابِ: لَقَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ فِي رَسُولِ اللَّهِ {saw}...
x: He is an excellent example for whoever hopes in Allah and the Last Day and remembers Allah often. The verse comes in the passage about the Confederates, when the believers were under siege.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:33:21}، وَجَاءَتِ الآيَةُ فِي سِيَاقِ غَزْوَةِ الأَحْزَابِ حِينَ حُوصِرَ المُسْلِمُونَ.

q: Complete: ﴾Muhammad is not but a…﴿
x: Messengers passed away before him. The verse continues: if he were to die or be killed, would you turn back on your heels?

q: The first House established for mankind is at which place, according to Surah Al ʿImran?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، أَيْنَ أَوَّلُ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ؟
x: Bakkah is another name for Makkah. Allah calls this first House ﴾blessed and a guidance for the worlds﴿, and says whoever enters it is safe.

q: Surah Ad-Duha reminds the Prophet {saw} that Allah found him as what, and gave him refuge?
تُذَكِّرُ سُورَةُ الضُّحَى النَّبِيَّ {saw} بِأَنَّ اللَّهَ وَجَدَهُ عَلَى أَيِّ حَالٍ فَآوَاهُ؟
x: Allah reminds him of His care from the very start. The surah then teaches: so do not mistreat the orphan, and do not turn away the one who asks.
ذَكَّرَهُ اللَّهُ بِرِعَايَتِهِ لَهُ مُنْذُ البِدَايَةِ، ثُمَّ قَالَ: {Q:93:9} {Q:93:10}.

q: Surah Ad-Duha says Allah found the Prophet {saw} in need, and then…
تَقُولُ سُورَةُ الضُّحَى إِنَّ اللَّهَ وَجَدَ النَّبِيَّ {saw} عَائِلًا، ثُمَّ...
x: The surah lists Allah’s gifts to him, and then closes: ﴾And as for the favour of your Lord, proclaim it.﴿
عَدَّدَتِ السُّورَةُ نِعَمَ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ، ثُمَّ خُتِمَتْ بِقَوْلِهِ: {Q:93:11}.

q: Before the Hijrah, the disbelievers plotted to restrain the Prophet {saw}, kill him, or…
قَبْلَ الهِجْرَةِ، مَكَرَ الكُفَّارُ بِالنَّبِيِّ {saw} لِيُثْبِتُوهُ أَوْ يَقْتُلُوهُ أَوْ...
x: Quraysh plotted to imprison him, kill him or drive him out. But Allah protected him: ﴾they plan, and Allah plans, and Allah is the best of planners﴿.

q: To whom was the Prophet {saw} sent, according to Surah Al-Aʿraf?
إِلَى مَنْ أُرْسِلَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَعْرَافِ؟
x: His message was for everyone, everywhere: ﴾Say: O mankind, I am the Messenger of Allah to you all﴿, the Messenger of the One to whom the heavens and earth belong.

q: Complete: ﴾O Prophet, We have sent you as a witness, a bringer of good tidings and a…﴿
x: The next verse continues: ﴾and one who invites to Allah by His permission, and an illuminating lamp﴿.

q: Whom was the Prophet {saw} commanded to warn first, according to Surah Ash-Shuʿaraʾ?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الشُّعَرَاءِ، مَنْ أُمِرَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} أَنْ يُنْذِرَهُمْ؟
x: He was told to begin with his own family and tribe, and the next verse adds: ﴾and lower your wing to the believers who follow you﴿.

q: Which battle, named in the Quran, was the first major victory of the Muslims?
مَا المَعْرَكَةُ المَذْكُورَةُ فِي القُرْآنِ الَّتِي كَانَتْ أَوَّلَ نَصْرٍ كَبِيرٍ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ؟
x: Allah reminds the believers that He gave them victory at Badr when they were weak and few, and supported them with angels.

q: The Battle of the Trench is also known by what name?
بِأَيِّ اسْمٍ آخَرَ تُعْرَفُ غَزْوَةُ الخَنْدَقِ؟
x: Al-Ahzab means “the Confederates”: several tribes joined forces against Madinah, and the believers dug a trench to defend the city.
الأَحْزَابُ هُمُ القَبَائِلُ المُتَحَالِفَةُ، وَبِاسْمِهِمْ سُمِّيَتِ السُّورَةُ الثَّالِثَةُ وَالثَّلَاثُونَ.

q: Before the qiblah was changed to the Kaʿbah, which direction did the Muslims face in prayer?
إِلَى أَيِّ قِبْلَةٍ كَانَ المُسْلِمُونَ يُصَلُّونَ قَبْلَ تَحْوِيلِهَا إِلَى الكَعْبَةِ؟
x: They faced Bayt al-Maqdis for a time after arriving in Madinah, until Allah turned them towards the Kaʿbah.
صَلَّوْا نَحْوَ بَيْتِ المَقْدِسِ سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ أَوْ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا بَعْدَ الهِجْرَةِ، ثُمَّ حُوِّلَتِ القِبْلَةُ.

q: The Night Journey took the Prophet {saw} from Al-Masjid al-Haram to which mosque?
أُسْرِيَ بِالنَّبِيِّ {saw} مِنَ المَسْجِدِ الحَرَامِ إِلَى أَيِّ مَسْجِدٍ؟
x: The journey is told in the opening verse of a surah that begins by glorifying Allah, who took His servant by night.
ذُكِرَ ذَلِكَ فِي مَطْلَعِ سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ.

q: What was the name of the Prophet’s {saw} mother?
مَا اسْمُ أُمِّ النَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
x: Aminah bint Wahb died when he was a young boy; his father ʿAbdullah had died before he was born.
آمِنَةُ بِنْتُ وَهْبٍ، وَتُوُفِّيَتْ وَهُوَ طِفْلٌ صَغِيرٌ.

q: Which uncle of the Prophet {saw} was martyred at the Battle of Uhud?
أَيُّ أَعْمَامِ النَّبِيِّ {saw} اسْتُشْهِدَ فِي غَزْوَةِ أُحُدٍ؟
x: Hamzah ibn ʿAbd al-Muttalib {ra}, who had defended the Prophet {saw} since the early days in Makkah, was among the martyrs of Uhud.
كَانَ حَمْزَةُ بْنُ عَبْدِ المُطَّلِبِ {ra} مِنْ شُهَدَاءِ أُحُدٍ.

q: After the first revelation, what did the Prophet {saw} say when he returned home trembling?
لَمَّا رَجَعَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} إِلَى بَيْتِهِ بَعْدَ أَوَّلِ الوَحْيِ يَرْجُفُ فُؤَادُهُ، مَاذَا قَالَ؟
x: He went to Khadijah {raf} and said “Cover me!”, and they covered him until his fear left him.
دَخَلَ عَلَى خَدِيجَةَ {raf} فَقَالَ: «زَمِّلُونِي زَمِّلُونِي»، فَزَمَّلُوهُ حَتَّى ذَهَبَ عَنْهُ الرَّوْعُ.

q: Khadijah {raf} took the Prophet {saw} to her cousin, who knew the earlier scriptures. Who was he?
انْطَلَقَتْ خَدِيجَةُ {raf} بِالنَّبِيِّ {saw} إِلَى ابْنِ عَمِّهَا العَالِمِ بِالكُتُبِ السَّابِقَةِ. مَنْ هُوَ؟
x: She took him to Waraqah ibn Nawfal, her cousin, who had become a Christian and wrote from the Injil.
انْطَلَقَتْ بِهِ إِلَى «وَرَقَةَ بْنَ نَوْفَلِ بْنِ أَسَدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ الْعُزَّى ابْنَ عَمِّ خَدِيجَةَ».

q: At the Battle of Hunayn, what did the Quran say made the Muslims overconfident?
فِي غَزْوَةِ حُنَيْنٍ، مَا الَّذِي قَالَ القُرْآنُ إِنَّهُ أَعْجَبَ المُسْلِمِينَ؟
x: The earth, vast as it was, felt narrow to them, and they turned back.

q: At Hudaybiyyah, under what did the believers pledge allegiance to the Prophet {saw}, earning Allah’s pleasure?
فِي الحُدَيْبِيَةِ، تَحْتَ مَاذَا بَايَعَ المُؤْمِنُونَ النَّبِيَّ {saw} فَرَضِيَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ؟
x: Allah was pleased with the believers when they pledged allegiance under the tree.

q: In the cave during the Hijrah, what did the Prophet {saw} say to his companion, as the Quran records?
فِي الغَارِ أَثْنَاءَ الهِجْرَةِ، مَاذَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} لِصَاحِبِهِ كَمَا حَكَى القُرْآنُ؟
o: “Do not grieve; indeed Allah is with us.”
x: Allah made the word of the disbelievers the lowest, while Allah’s word is the highest.

q: Before Badr, what did Allah send down from the sky to purify the believers?
قَبْلَ بَدْرٍ، مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ لِيُطَهِّرَ المُؤْمِنِينَ؟
x: Allah sent down water to purify them and to make their feet firm.

q: Before Badr, what did Allah cover the believers with, as a reassurance from Him?
قَبْلَ بَدْرٍ، بِمَاذَا غَشَّى اللَّهُ المُؤْمِنِينَ أَمَنَةً مِنْهُ؟
x: In the tension before battle, a calm drowsiness came over them, a sign of security from Allah.

q: Complete: ﴾And you did not throw when you threw, but…﴿
x: Every success came from Allah. The same verse calls the battle a test from Him, a good test.

q: At Uhud, how many groups among the believers almost lost courage?
يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، كَمْ طَائِفَةً مِنَ المُؤْمِنِينَ هَمَّتْ أَنْ تَفْشَلَ؟
x: Allah was their protector, and they held firm. The verse ends: upon Allah let the believers rely.

q: When the believers saw the Confederates, what did they say?
لَمَّا رَأَى المُؤْمِنُونَ الأَحْزَابَ، مَاذَا قَالُوا؟
o: This is what Allah and His Messenger promised us
x: It only increased them in faith and submission.

q: After Hudaybiyyah, Surah Al-Fath promised the believers they would enter which place in safety?
بَعْدَ الحُدَيْبِيَةِ، وَعَدَتْ سُورَةُ الفَتْحِ المُؤْمِنِينَ بِدُخُولِ أَيِّ مَكَانٍ آمِنِينَ؟
x: The promise came true: the believers later entered it, heads shaved or hair shortened, just as the verse described.

q: In Surah At-Tawbah, when told to go forth in the cause of Allah, what did some cling heavily to?
فِي سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ، إِذَا قِيلَ لِبَعْضِهِمُ انْفِرُوا فِي سَبِيلِ اللَّهِ، إِلَى أَيِّ شَيْءٍ اثَّاقَلُوا؟
x: ﴾…you cling heavily to the earth? Are you satisfied with the life of this world rather than the Hereafter?﴿

q: According to Surah Al-Israʾ, why was the Prophet {saw} taken on the Night Journey?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ، لِمَاذَا أُسْرِيَ بِالنَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
o: To be shown some of Allah’s signs
x: The verse begins by glorifying Allah and ends: ﴾Indeed, He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing﴿.

q: Before the qiblah changed, what did Allah see the Prophet {saw} doing?
قَبْلَ تَحْوِيلِ القِبْلَةِ، مَاذَا رَأَى اللَّهُ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
o: Turning his face towards the sky
x: He hoped for a change, and Allah promised to turn him towards a qiblah that would please him.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, who would ask what turned the Muslims away from their former qiblah?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَنْ سَيَقُولُ: مَا وَلَّاهُمْ عَنْ قِبْلَتِهِمُ الَّتِي كَانُوا عَلَيْهَا؟
x: The reply: to Allah belong the east and the west, and He guides whom He wills.

q: According to Surah Al ʿImran, what would have happened had the Prophet {saw} been harsh and hard-hearted?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، مَاذَا كَانَ سَيَحْدُثُ لَوْ كَانَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} فَظًّا غَلِيظَ القَلْبِ؟
o: People would have dispersed from around him
He would have been a king
x: Allah praises the Prophet’s {saw} gentleness, which kept people close to him.

q: What is the treaty made with Quraysh in 6 AH called?
مَا اسْمُ الصُّلْحِ الَّذِي عُقِدَ مَعَ قُرَيْشٍ سَنَةَ 6 هـ؟
x: On the way back, Allah revealed that it was ﴾a clear victory﴿, even though many had seen the terms as a setback.
نَزَلَتْ سُورَةُ الفَتْحِ فِي طَرِيقِ العَوْدَةِ مِنْهُ.

q: Which mosque did the Prophet {saw} found first on reaching Madinah?
مَا أَوَّلُ مَسْجِدٍ أَسَّسَهُ النَّبِيُّ {saw} عِنْدَ وُصُولِهِ إِلَى المَدِينَةِ؟
x: He stayed at Quba on the outskirts of Madinah and founded its mosque before entering the city.
نَزَلَ بِقُبَاءٍ فِي أَطْرَافِ المَدِينَةِ وَأَسَّسَ مَسْجِدَهَا قَبْلَ دُخُولِهِ المَدِينَةَ.

q: In which year of the Hijrah was Makkah conquered?
فِي أَيِّ سَنَةٍ هِجْرِيَّةٍ كَانَ فَتْحُ مَكَّةَ؟
x: He entered Makkah almost without fighting and forgave its people, who had opposed him for years.
كَانَ فَتْحُ مَكَّةَ فِي رَمَضَانَ سَنَةَ 8 هـ.

q: In which year of the Hijrah was the Farewell Pilgrimage?
فِي أَيِّ سَنَةٍ هِجْرِيَّةٍ كَانَتْ حَجَّةُ الوَدَاعِ؟
x: It was his only Hajj after the Hijrah, a few months before his passing in 11 AH.
هِيَ حَجَّتُهُ الوَحِيدَةُ بَعْدَ الهِجْرَةِ، وَكَانَتْ قَبْلَ وَفَاتِهِ سَنَةَ 11 هـ بِأَشْهُرٍ.

q: Which uncle raised and protected the Prophet {saw} after his grandfather died?
أَيُّ أَعْمَامِ النَّبِيِّ {saw} كَفَلَهُ وَحَمَاهُ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ جَدِّهِ؟
x: Abu Talib took him in after the death of ʿAbd al-Muttalib and defended him against Quraysh for years.
كَفَلَهُ أَبُو طَالِبٍ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ عَبْدِ المُطَّلِبِ، وَدَافَعَ عَنْهُ أَمَامَ قُرَيْشٍ سِنِينَ.

q: In which year of the Hijrah was the Battle of Badr?
فِي أَيِّ سَنَةٍ هِجْرِيَّةٍ كَانَتْ غَزْوَةُ بَدْرٍ؟
x: It fell in Ramadan of 2 AH. The Quran calls it the day the two armies met.
كَانَتْ غَزْوَةُ بَدْرٍ فِي رَمَضَانَ سَنَةَ 2 هـ.

q: Waraqah ibn Nawfal said the angel who came to the Prophet {saw} was the same one Allah had sent down to which prophet?
قَالَ وَرَقَةُ بْنُ نَوْفَلٍ إِنَّ الَّذِي جَاءَ النَّبِيَّ {saw} هُوَ النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي أَنْزَلَهُ اللَّهُ عَلَى أَيِّ نَبِيٍّ؟
x: Waraqah recognised the angel as the same one sent to earlier prophets.
قَالَ وَرَقَةُ: «هَذَا النَّامُوسُ الَّذِي نَزَّلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى مُوسَى».

q: How does Surah Al-Ahzab describe the believers when the enemy came at them from above and below?
بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ الأَحْزَابِ حَالَ المُؤْمِنِينَ حِينَ جَاءَهُمُ العَدُوُّ مِنْ فَوْقِهِمْ وَمِنْ أَسْفَلَ مِنْهُمْ؟
o: Eyes shifted and hearts reached the throats
x: The believers were shaken severely, and some began to have doubts about Allah.

q: What did Khadijah {raf} say to reassure the Prophet {saw} after the first revelation?
بِمَاذَا طَمْأَنَتْ خَدِيجَةُ {raf} النَّبِيَّ {saw} بَعْدَ أَوَّلِ الوَحْيِ؟
o: “By Allah, Allah will never disgrace you.”
x: She reminded him that he kept family ties, carried others’ burdens, honoured guests and helped in times of need.
قالت: «كَلاَّ وَاللَّهِ مَا يُخْزِيكَ اللَّهُ أَبَدًا، إِنَّكَ لَتَصِلُ الرَّحِمَ».

q: In Surah Al-Anfal, with how many angels did Allah say He would reinforce the believers at Badr?
فِي سُورَةِ الأَنْفَالِ، بِكَمْ مِنَ المَلَائِكَةِ وَعَدَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُمِدَّ المُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ؟
x: Allah answered their call for help with a thousand angels, one after another.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:8:9}.

q: Which was the first prayer the Prophet {saw} prayed facing the Kaʿbah?
مَا أَوَّلُ صَلَاةٍ صَلَّاهَا النَّبِيُّ {saw} نَحْوَ الكَعْبَةِ؟
x: The first prayer he prayed towards the Kaʿbah was the ʿAsr prayer, with people praying behind him.
«وَأَنَّهُ صَلَّى أَوَّلَ صَلاَةٍ صَلاَّهَا صَلاَةَ الْعَصْرِ».

q: Before Badr, Allah promised the believers one of how many groups?
قَبْلَ بَدْرٍ، وَعَدَ اللَّهُ المُؤْمِنِينَ إِحْدَى كَمْ طَائِفَةً؟
x: They wished the unarmed one would be theirs, but Allah willed to establish the truth.

q: At Badr, where was the caravan in relation to the believers?
يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، أَيْنَ كَانَ الرَّكْبُ بِالنِّسْبَةِ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ؟
x: The believers were on the near side of the valley, the enemy on the far side, and the caravan below them.

q: When the armies met at Badr, how did Allah make the enemy appear in the believers’ eyes?
لَمَّا التَقَى الجَمْعَانِ يَوْمَ بَدْرٍ، كَيْفَ أَرَى اللَّهُ المُؤْمِنِينَ عَدُوَّهُمْ؟
x: And He made the believers appear few in their eyes, so that Allah would accomplish a matter already decreed.

q: At Uhud, after Allah’s promise was fulfilled, what did some believers do, according to Surah Al ʿImran?
يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ، بَعْدَ أَنْ صَدَقَهُمُ اللَّهُ وَعْدَهُ، مَاذَا فَعَلَ بَعْضُ المُؤْمِنِينَ بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ؟
x: Some of them desired this world, and some desired the Hereafter; yet Allah pardoned them.

q: As the believers fled up the hill at Uhud, where was the Messenger {saw}, according to Surah Al ʿImran?
لَمَّا صَعِدَ المُؤْمِنُونَ يَوْمَ أُحُدٍ وَلَا يَلْوُونَ عَلَى أَحَدٍ، أَيْنَ كَانَ الرَّسُولُ {saw}؟
o: On a horse at the front
x: Allah repaid them with distress upon distress, so they would not grieve over what they had missed.

q: Which old name of Madinah appears in Surah Al-Ahzab?
مَا الاِسْمُ القَدِيمُ لِلْمَدِينَةِ الَّذِي وَرَدَ فِي سُورَةِ الأَحْزَابِ؟
x: A group said: O people of Yathrib, there is no stand for you, so go back.

q: How did the Battle of the Confederates end, according to Surah Al-Ahzab?
كَيْفَ انْتَهَتْ غَزْوَةُ الأَحْزَابِ بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَحْزَابِ؟
o: Allah turned them back in their rage, having gained nothing
رَدَّهُمُ اللَّهُ بِغَيْظِهِمْ لَمْ يَنَالُوا خَيْرًا
x: Allah spared the believers the fighting. The verse ends: Allah is ever Powerful and Mighty.

q: Where does Surah Al-Fath say Allah held back the hands of both sides from each other?
أَيْنَ قَالَتْ سُورَةُ الفَتْحِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَفَّ أَيْدِيَ الفَرِيقَيْنِ عَنْ بَعْضِهِمَا؟
