x: ﴾It is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within Makkah.﴿

q: How many were left behind until the earth, vast as it is, felt narrow to them, before Allah accepted their repentance?
كَمْ كَانَ الَّذِينَ خُلِّفُوا حَتَّى ضَاقَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ الأَرْضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتْ ثُمَّ تَابَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِمْ؟
x: They had stayed behind without an excuse. They were accepted once they knew there was no refuge from Allah except in Him.

q: In Surah At-Tawbah, what did some people build ﴾to cause harm and disbelief and division among the believers﴿?
فِي سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ، مَاذَا اتَّخَذَ بَعْضُهُمْ {Q:9:107:4-8}؟
x: Allah told the Prophet {saw} never to pray in it, and praised instead a mosque founded on piety.

q: Who said: ﴾If we return to Madinah, the more honourable will surely expel the more humble﴿?
x: Allah answered: honour belongs to Allah, His Messenger and the believers, but the hypocrites do not know.

q: How many years did the Prophet {saw} stay in Makkah after revelation began?
كَمْ سَنَةً مَكَثَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} فِي مَكَّةَ بَعْدَ بَدْءِ الوَحْيِ؟
x: Ibn ʿAbbas {ra}: he stayed thirteen years in Makkah, then was commanded to emigrate and stayed ten years in Madinah.
قَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ {ra}: مَكَثَ ثَلَاثَ عَشْرَةَ سَنَةً، ثُمَّ أُمِرَ بِالهِجْرَةِ فَمَكَثَ بِالمَدِينَةِ عَشْرَ سِنِينَ.

q: Which Companion is the only one mentioned by name in the Quran?
مَنِ الصَّحَابِيُّ الوَحِيدُ الَّذِي ذُكِرَ اسْمُهُ فِي القُرْآنِ؟
x: Zayd {ra} is the only Companion named in the Quran.
ذُكِرَ زَيْدٌ {ra} بِاسْمِهِ فِي سُورَةِ الأَحْزَابِ.

q: The Pledges of al-ʿAqabah were made with people from which city?
مِنْ أَيِّ مَدِينَةٍ كَانَ الَّذِينَ بَايَعُوا النَّبِيَّ {saw} فِي العَقَبَةِ؟
x: Believers from Yathrib pledged at al-ʿAqabah to support the Prophet {saw}, which opened the way for his move to their city.
مَهَّدَتْ هَاتَانِ البَيْعَتَانِ لِلْهِجْرَةِ إِلَى المَدِينَةِ.

q: In which year of the Hijrah was the Battle of Uhud?
فِي أَيِّ سَنَةٍ هِجْرِيَّةٍ كَانَتْ غَزْوَةُ أُحُدٍ؟
x: Uhud was fought in Shawwal of 3 AH, beside the mountain north of Madinah.
كَانَتْ غَزْوَةُ أُحُدٍ فِي شَوَّالٍ سَنَةَ 3 هـ عِنْدَ الجَبَلِ شَمَالَ المَدِينَةِ.

q: The expedition to Tabuk in 9 AH set out against which power?
إِلَى مَنْ خَرَجَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} فِي غَزْوَةِ تَبُوكَ سَنَةَ 9 هـ؟
x: It was his last military expedition, made in intense heat, and the Quran speaks of those who went and those who stayed behind.
كَانَتْ آخِرَ غَزَوَاتِهِ، وَتَحَدَّثَتْ عَنْهَا سُورَةُ التَّوْبَةِ.

q: For how long did the Prophet {saw} pray towards Bayt al-Maqdis after arriving in Madinah?
كَمْ صَلَّى النَّبِيُّ {saw} نَحْوَ بَيْتِ المَقْدِسِ بَعْدَ قُدُومِهِ المَدِينَةَ؟
o: سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ أَوْ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا
x: Al-Baraʾ {ra} reported it, adding that the Prophet {saw} loved to face the Kaʿbah.
«وَأَنَّهُ صَلَّى قِبَلَ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ سِتَّةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا، أَوْ سَبْعَةَ عَشَرَ شَهْرًا».

q: In the cave, what did Abu Bakr {ra} say would happen if one of the pursuers looked down at his feet?
فِي الغَارِ، مَاذَا قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ {ra} لَوْ نَظَرَ أَحَدُ المُشْرِكِينَ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيْهِ؟
x: The Prophet {saw} answered: what do you think of two, the third of whom is Allah?
قَالَ: «لَوْ أَنَّ أَحَدَهُمْ نَظَرَ تَحْتَ قَدَمَيْهِ لأَبْصَرَنَا».

q: Before revelation began, what came to be beloved to the Prophet {saw}?
قَبْلَ نُزُولِ الوَحْيِ، مَاذَا حُبِّبَ إِلَى النَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
x: Seclusion became beloved to him, and he would worship in the Cave of Hiraʾ.
«ثُمَّ حُبِّبَ إِلَيْهِ الْخَلاَءُ».

q: According to ʿAʾishah {raf}, how did revelation first begin?
كَيْفَ بَدَأَ الوَحْيُ كَمَا رَوَتْ عَائِشَةُ {raf}؟
o: With a voice from the sky
x: Every dream he saw came true like the light of daybreak.
«أَوَّلُ مَا بُدِئَ بِهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم مِنَ الْوَحْىِ الرُّؤْيَا الصَّالِحَةُ فِي النَّوْمِ».

q: Waraqah ibn Nawfal wished he would be alive when what happened?
تَمَنَّى وَرَقَةُ بْنُ نَوْفَلٍ أَنْ يَكُونَ حَيًّا حِينَ يَحْدُثُ مَاذَا؟
o: When the Prophet’s people drive him out
x: The Prophet {saw} asked in surprise: will they drive me out? Waraqah said every man who brought such a message faced hostility.
قَالَ وَرَقَةُ: «لَيْتَنِي أَكُونُ حَيًّا إِذْ يُخْرِجُكَ قَوْمُكَ».

q: According to Surah An-Najm, where did the Prophet {saw} see Jibril a second time?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ النَّجْمِ، أَيْنَ رَأَى النَّبِيُّ {saw} جِبْرِيلَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَى؟
o: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary
x: ﴾And he certainly saw him in another descent, at the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary.﴿

q: In Surah An-Najm, how close did the angel come?
فِي سُورَةِ النَّجْمِ، كَمْ كَانَ قُرْبُ المَلَكِ؟
x: So close that the angel came within two bow-lengths or nearer, and revealed to Allah’s servant what He revealed.

q: What does Surah Al-Anfal call the day the two armies met at Badr?
بِمَاذَا سَمَّتْ سُورَةُ الأَنْفَالِ يَوْمَ التَقَى الجَمْعَانِ؟
x: The day truth was distinguished from falsehood.

q: Before Uhud, what was the Prophet {saw} doing when he left his family early in the morning?
قَبْلَ أُحُدٍ، مَاذَا كَانَ يَفْعَلُ النَّبِيُّ {saw} حِينَ غَدَا مِنْ أَهْلِهِ؟
o: Assigning the believers their battle positions
Leading the Fajr prayer in Quba
x: He left home early to place the believers in their positions, and Allah was hearing and knowing.

q: What did Allah send against the Confederates, according to Surah Al-Ahzab?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَحْزَابِ، مَاذَا أَرْسَلَ اللَّهُ عَلَى الأَحْزَابِ؟
o: A wind, and soldiers you did not see
x: The verse reminds the believers to remember Allah’s favour when armies came against them.

q: At Hudaybiyyah, what did the disbelievers put into their hearts, according to Surah Al-Fath?
فِي الحُدَيْبِيَةِ، مَاذَا جَعَلَ الكُفَّارُ فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الفَتْحِ؟
x: The believers held firm, and Allah made them keep to the word of piety.

q: At Hudaybiyyah, what was held back from reaching its place of sacrifice?
فِي الحُدَيْبِيَةِ، مَا الَّذِي مُنِعَ أَنْ يَبْلُغَ مَحِلَّهُ؟
x: The Muslims were prevented from reaching the Sacred Mosque, and the animals were held back from their place of sacrifice.

q: Complete: ﴾Go forth, whether light or…﴿
x: The verse continues: and strive with your wealth and your lives in the cause of Allah.

q: Complete: ﴾Among the believers are men who have been true to what they…﴿
x: Some have fulfilled their vow, and some are still waiting, and they have not changed in the least.

q: In Surah Al-Hashr, whom did Allah expel from their homes ﴾at the first gathering﴿?
فِي سُورَةِ الحَشْرِ، مَنْ أَخْرَجَ اللَّهُ مِنْ دِيَارِهِمْ لِأَوَّلِ الحَشْرِ؟
o: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book
x: They thought their fortresses would protect them from Allah, but He came at them from where they did not expect.

q: How many times did the angel press the Prophet {saw} tightly before revealing the first verses?
كَمْ مَرَّةً غَطَّ المَلَكُ النَّبِيَّ {saw} قَبْلَ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ عَلَيْهِ أَوَائِلَ سُورَةِ العَلَقِ؟
x: After the angel pressed him the final time, he recited the opening verses of Surah Al-ʿAlaq.
«فَأَخَذَنِي فَغَطَّنِي الثَّالِثَةَ، ثُمَّ أَرْسَلَنِي».

q: Waraqah said that no man ever came with what the Prophet {saw} brought except that he was…
قَالَ وَرَقَةُ: لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ قَطُّ بِمِثْلِ مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ إِلَّا...
x: Waraqah said every messenger before him had faced hostility, and promised to support him if he lived.
«لَمْ يَأْتِ رَجُلٌ قَطُّ بِمِثْلِ مَا جِئْتَ بِهِ إِلاَّ عُودِيَ».

q: What was Waraqah ibn Nawfal’s condition when Khadijah {raf} brought the Prophet {saw} to him?
مَا حَالُ وَرَقَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ حِينَ جَاءَتْهُ خَدِيجَةُ {raf} بِالنَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
o: An old man who had gone blind
x: He was an old man who had lost his sight, yet he recognised the truth at once.
«وَكَانَ شَيْخًا كَبِيرًا قَدْ عَمِيَ».

q: In which language did Waraqah write from the Injil?
بِأَيِّ لُغَةٍ كَانَ وَرَقَةُ يَكْتُبُ مِنَ الإِنْجِيلِ؟
x: He used to write the Hebrew scripture, writing from the Injil in Hebrew.
«وَكَانَ يَكْتُبُ الْكِتَابَ الْعِبْرَانِيَّ، فَيَكْتُبُ مِنَ الإِنْجِيلِ بِالْعِبْرَانِيَّةِ».

q: What happened after Waraqah ibn Nawfal passed away?
مَاذَا حَدَثَ بَعْدَ وَفَاةِ وَرَقَةَ بْنِ نَوْفَلٍ؟
x: Waraqah passed away soon after, and revelation paused for a while.
«ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْشَبْ وَرَقَةُ أَنْ تُوُفِّيَ وَفَتَرَ الْوَحْىُ».

q: According to Ibn ʿAbbas {ra}, how many years did the Prophet {saw} live in Madinah?
كَمْ سَنَةً عَاشَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} فِي المَدِينَةِ كَمَا رَوَى ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ {ra}؟
x: He was commanded to emigrate, went to Madinah and stayed there ten years.
«ثُمَّ أُمِرَ بِالْهِجْرَةِ، فَهَاجَرَ إِلَى الْمَدِينَةِ، فَمَكَثَ بِهَا عَشْرَ سِنِينَ».

q: When the Prophet {saw} first arrived in Madinah, with whom did he stay, according to al-Baraʾ {ra}?
لَمَّا قَدِمَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} المَدِينَةَ، عَلَى مَنْ نَزَلَ أَوَّلًا كَمَا رَوَى البَرَاءُ {ra}؟
o: His grandfathers or maternal uncles from the Ansar
x: Al-Baraʾ said he stayed with his grandfathers, or his maternal uncles, from the Ansar.
«نَزَلَ عَلَى أَجْدَادِهِ ـ أَوْ قَالَ أَخْوَالِهِ ـ مِنَ الأَنْصَارِ».

q: In Surah Al ʿImran, how many angels were first promised to reinforce the believers?
فِي سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، بِكَمْ مِنَ المَلَائِكَةِ وُعِدَ المُؤْمِنُونَ أَوَّلًا؟
x: ﴾Is it not enough that your Lord reinforces you with three thousand angels sent down?﴿

q: In Surah Al ʿImran, if the believers were patient and mindful, how many marked angels were promised?
فِي سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، بِكَمْ مِنَ المَلَائِكَةِ المُسَوِّمِينَ وُعِدَ المُؤْمِنُونَ إِنْ صَبَرُوا وَاتَّقَوْا؟
x: The promise came with a condition: patience and mindfulness of Allah.

q: After the pledge under the tree, what did Allah reward the believers with, as Surah Al-Fath states?
بِمَاذَا أَثَابَ اللَّهُ المُؤْمِنِينَ بَعْدَ بَيْعَةِ الشَّجَرَةِ كَمَا فِي سُورَةِ الفَتْحِ؟
x: Allah knew what was in their hearts, and rewarded them with a near victory and much spoils.

q: After the Muslims turned back at Hunayn, what did Allah send down, according to Surah At-Tawbah?
بَعْدَ أَنْ وَلَّى المُسْلِمُونَ يَوْمَ حُنَيْنٍ، مَاذَا أَنْزَلَ اللَّهُ كَمَا فِي سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ؟
o: His tranquillity and soldiers you did not see
x: Allah sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and the believers, and soldiers they did not see.

q: According to Surah Al-Israʾ, what has Allah done to the surroundings of al-Masjid al-Aqsa?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ، مَاذَا فَعَلَ اللَّهُ بِمَا حَوْلَ المَسْجِدِ الأَقْصَى؟
x: The verse describes the Night Journey, which ended at a mosque whose surroundings Allah blessed.

q: Complete Surah An-Najm: ﴾He certainly saw of the greatest…﴿
x: During the Ascension, he saw some of the greatest signs of his Lord.

q: In Surah Al-Anfal, twenty patient believers would overcome how many?
فِي سُورَةِ الأَنْفَالِ، عِشْرُونَ صَابِرُونَ يَغْلِبُونَ كَمْ؟
x: Allah told the Prophet {saw} to urge the believers on, promising that patient believers would overcome many times their number.

q: After Allah lightened the burden, how many would a hundred patient believers overcome?
بَعْدَ أَنْ خَفَّفَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ، كَمْ تَغْلِبُ مِئَةٌ صَابِرَةٌ؟
x: The verse eased the earlier ruling, because Allah knew there was weakness among them.

q: At the Trench, who said ﴾Allah and His Messenger promised us nothing but delusion﴿?
يَوْمَ الخَنْدَقِ، مَنْ قَالَ: مَا وَعَدَنَا اللَّهُ وَرَسُولُهُ إِلَّا غُرُورًا؟
o: The hypocrites and those with disease in their hearts
x: In the siege, the hypocrites’ doubts came out, while the believers’ faith only grew.

q: Surah Al ʿImran praises believers who responded to Allah and the Messenger after what had struck them?
تُثْنِي سُورَةُ آلِ عِمْرَانَ عَلَى الَّذِينَ اسْتَجَابُوا لِلَّهِ وَالرَّسُولِ مِنْ بَعْدِ مَاذَا؟
x: Even after injury at Uhud, they answered the call, and for those who did good there is a great reward.

q: When told ﴾the people have gathered against you, so fear them﴿, what did the believers say?
لَمَّا قِيلَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ: إِنَّ النَّاسَ قَدْ جَمَعُوا لَكُمْ فَاخْشَوْهُمْ، مَاذَا قَالُوا؟
o: Allah is sufficient for us, and He is the best disposer of affairs
x: It only increased them in faith, and they returned with Allah’s favour and bounty.

q: Before Badr, how did Allah show the enemy to the Prophet {saw} in his dream?
قَبْلَ بَدْرٍ، كَيْفَ أَرَى اللَّهُ النَّبِيَّ {saw} عَدُوَّهُ فِي مَنَامِهِ؟
x: Had He shown them as many, the believers would have lost heart and disputed.

q: How does Surah An-Nasr describe people entering the religion of Allah?
كَيْفَ وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ النَّصْرِ دُخُولَ النَّاسِ فِي دِينِ اللَّهِ؟
x: Revealed when victory came, the surah tells the Prophet {saw} to glorify his Lord and seek His forgiveness.

q: According to Surah At-Tawbah, how many months are there with Allah, and how many of them are sacred?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ، كَمْ عِدَّةُ الشُّهُورِ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ، وَكَمْ مِنْهَا حُرُمٌ؟
x: The same verse says: do not wrong yourselves during them.

q: Which sign does Surah Al-Qamar mention as the Hour drew near?
مَا الآيَةُ الَّتِي ذَكَرَتْهَا سُورَةُ القَمَرِ حِينَ اقْتَرَبَتِ السَّاعَةُ؟
x: The next verse says that when they see a sign they turn away and call it passing magic.

q: Complete the hadith: “Actions are only by…”
أكمل الحديث: «إِنَّمَا الْأَعْمَالُ ...»
x: It is the very first hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari. Every deed is judged by its intention, and each person gets what they intended.
هُوَ أَوَّلُ حَدِيثٍ فِي صَحِيحِ البُخَارِيِّ، وَفِيهِ: «وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى».

q: On how many pillars is Islam built?
عَلَى كَمْ رُكْنٍ بُنِيَ الإِسْلَامُ؟
x: Islam rests on these five like a building on its pillars; everything else in a Muslim’s practice is built on them.
شَهَادَةُ أَنْ لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ، وَإِقَامُ الصَّلَاةِ، وَإِيتَاءُ الزَّكَاةِ، وَالحَجُّ، وَصَوْمُ رَمَضَانَ.

q: Complete: “The strong person is not the one who wrestles others down. The strong one is he who…”
أكمل: «لَيْسَ الشَّدِيدُ بِالصُّرَعَةِ، إِنَّمَا الشَّدِيدُ الَّذِي ...»
x: Real strength is not physical: it is keeping control of yourself at the very moment anger rises.
القُوَّةُ الحَقِيقِيَّةُ فِي ضَبْطِ النَّفْسِ سَاعَةَ الغَضَبِ.

q: A man asked who most deserves his good companionship. Whom did the Prophet {saw} name three times?
سَأَلَ رَجُلٌ عَنْ أَحَقِّ النَّاسِ بِحُسْنِ صَحَابَتِهِ، فَمَنْ ذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} ثَلَاثَ مَرَّاتٍ؟
x: He said “your mother” three times, and only then “your father”, showing the special right of mothers.
قَالَ: «أُمُّكَ» ثَلَاثًا، ثُمَّ قَالَ: «ثُمَّ أَبُوكَ».

q: Complete: “The Muslim is the one from whose ___ the Muslims are safe.”
أكمل: «الْمُسْلِمُ مَنْ سَلِمَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ مِنْ ...»
x: Harm done with words counts just as much as harm done with hands, so a true Muslim keeps both in check.
أَذَى اللِّسَانِ كَأَذَى اليَدِ.

q: Complete: “The best of you are those who learn the Quran and…”
أكمل: «خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَ ...»
x: Narrated by ʿUthman ibn ʿAffan {ra}. The best people are those who both learn the Quran and pass it on to others.
رَوَاهُ عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عَفَّانَ {ra}.

q: Complete: “A good word is…”
أكمل: «وَالْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ ...»
x: Part of a hadith listing everyday charity, like helping someone onto their mount and removing harm from the road.
جُزْءٌ مِنْ حَدِيثٍ يُعَدِّدُ صُوَرَ الصَّدَقَةِ اليَوْمِيَّةِ، كَإِعَانَةِ الرَّجُلِ عَلَى دَابَّتِهِ وَإِمَاطَةِ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ.

q: At the end of the hadith about Islam, Iman and Ihsan, who did the Prophet {saw} say the questioner was?
فِي آخِرِ حَدِيثِ الإِسْلَامِ وَالإِيمَانِ وَالإِحْسَانِ، مَنْ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} إِنَّ السَّائِلَ كَانَ؟
x: This is the famous Hadith of Jibril: a stranger came to the Prophet {saw} and asked about the foundations of the religion and the Hour. Afterwards the Prophet {saw} revealed who he was.
هُوَ حَدِيثُ جِبْرِيلَ المَشْهُورُ: جَاءَ رَجُلٌ غَرِيبٌ فَسَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ {saw} عَنْ أُصُولِ الدِّينِ وَعَنِ السَّاعَةِ.

q: Complete: “And the emigrant (muhajir) is the one who leaves…”
أكمل: «وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ ...»
x: The true emigrant is not only the one who changes his home, but the one who leaves behind what Allah has forbidden.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَالْمُهَاجِرُ مَنْ هَجَرَ مَا نَهَى اللَّهُ عَنْهُ».

q: Complete: “Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him not harm his…”
أكمل: «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِ ...»
x: Being a good neighbour is a sign of true faith in Allah and the Last Day.
قَالَ {saw}: «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلاَ يُؤْذِ جَارَهُ».

q: Complete: “Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him honour his…”
أكمل: «وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ...»
x: Hospitality is part of faith itself, not just good manners.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَمَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيُكْرِمْ ضَيْفَهُ».

q: Complete: “Allah helps the servant as long as the servant is helping his…”
أكمل: «وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ ...»
x: While you are busy helping someone, Allah is helping you.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَاللَّهُ فِي عَوْنِ الْعَبْدِ مَا كَانَ الْعَبْدُ فِي عَوْنِ أَخِيهِ».

q: Complete: “The halal is clear and the haram is…”
أكمل: «الْحَلاَلُ بَيِّنٌ وَ ...»
x: Between the clearly lawful and the clearly forbidden lie doubtful matters that many people do not know.
قَالَ {saw}: «الْحَلاَلُ بَيِّنٌ وَالْحَرَامُ بَيِّنٌ، وَبَيْنَهُمَا مُشَبَّهَاتٌ لاَ يَعْلَمُهَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ».

q: Complete: “Whoever Allah wants good for, He gives him understanding of…”
أكمل: «مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي ...»
x: Understanding the religion is a sign that Allah wants good for a person. That is why learning it matters so much.
قَالَ {saw}: «مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ».

q: Complete: “The Muslim is the brother of the Muslim; he does not wrong him, nor…”
أكمل: «الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ، لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ ...»
x: A Muslim never wrongs his brother or leaves him to harm. The same hadith promises: whoever meets his brother’s need, Allah will meet his.
قَالَ {saw}: «الْمُسْلِمُ أَخُو الْمُسْلِمِ، لاَ يَظْلِمُهُ وَلاَ يُسْلِمُهُ، وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ اللَّهُ فِي حَاجَتِهِ».

q: The believers in their mercy, love and kindness to one another are like one…
مَثَلُ المُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ...
x: When one part of the body hurts, the whole body feels it. That is how believers should feel one another’s pain.
قَالَ {saw}: «تَرَى الْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي تَرَاحُمِهِمْ وَتَوَادِّهِمْ وَتَعَاطُفِهِمْ كَمَثَلِ الْجَسَدِ».

q: Complete: “Truthfulness leads to…”
أكمل: «إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى ...»
x: Truthfulness leads to righteousness, and righteousness leads to Paradise. Small honest choices add up to a whole life.
قَالَ {saw}: «إِنَّ الصِّدْقَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْبِرِّ، وَإِنَّ الْبِرَّ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ».

q: Two blessings many people are cheated of: health and…
نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ: الصِّحَّةُ وَ...
x: Health and free time are blessings that many people let slip away without using them well.
قَالَ {saw}: «نِعْمَتَانِ مَغْبُونٌ فِيهِمَا كَثِيرٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ، الصِّحَّةُ وَالْفَرَاغُ».

q: Complete: “Be in this world as though you were a stranger or a…”
أكمل: «كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ، أَوْ ...»
x: A traveller only rests briefly on the road home. The advice is to live in this world the same way: lightly, and always heading onward.
قَالَ {saw}: «كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ، أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ».

q: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the…
المُؤْمِنُ القَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ...
x: The hadith adds: “and in both there is good.” Strength is praised, but every believer has worth.
قَالَ {saw}: «الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ».

q: How wonderful is the affair of the believer! All of his affairs are…
عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ المُؤْمِنِ! إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ...
x: Ease and hardship can both become good for the believer, depending on how he responds to them.
قَالَ {saw}: «عَجَبًا لأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ».

q: When a person dies, their deeds come to an end except for how many things?
إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلَّا مِنْ كَمْ؟
x: Most deeds stop at death, but three kinds of good keep bringing reward long after a person is gone.
قَالَ {saw}: «إِذَا مَاتَ الإِنْسَانُ انْقَطَعَ عَنْهُ عَمَلُهُ إِلاَّ مِنْ ثَلاَثَةٍ».

q: Allah says: “I am as My servant thinks of Me, and I am with him when he…”
يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: «أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ...»
x: This is a hadith qudsi: words of Allah reported by the Prophet {saw}, outside the Quran. It invites us to think well of Allah and remember Him often.
«أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي، وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي».

q: A man asked the Prophet {saw} for advice. What did he say, repeating it several times?
طَلَبَ رَجُلٌ مِنَ النَّبِيِّ {saw} الوَصِيَّةَ، فَمَاذَا قَالَ لَهُ مُكَرِّرًا؟
x: The man asked again and again, and each time the answer was the same: “Do not become angry.”
رَدَّدَ الرَّجُلُ مِرَارًا، فَقَالَ فِي كُلِّ مَرَّةٍ: «لاَ تَغْضَبْ».

q: Complete: “None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he…”
أكمل: «لا يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا ...»
x: Wanting good for others as you want it for yourself is part of complete faith.
حُبُّ الخَيْرِ لِلنَّاسِ كَمَا تُحِبُّهُ لِنَفْسِكَ مِنْ كَمَالِ الإِيمَانِ.

q: Complete: “Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or…”
أكمل: «مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ ...»
x: Every word counts: if what you are about to say is not good, silence is better.
حِفْظُ اللِّسَانِ مِنْ عَلَامَاتِ صِدْقِ الإِيمَانِ.

q: Complete: “Make things easy and do not make them hard. Give glad tidings and do not…”
أكمل: «يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا، وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ ...»
x: A guiding rule for teaching and inviting others: make the religion easy to love, never a burden.
قَاعِدَةٌ فِي التَّعْلِيمِ وَالدَّعْوَةِ إِلَى اللَّهِ.

q: Complete: “Charity never decreases…”
أكمل: «مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ ...»
x: Giving never truly reduces what you have. The Quran promises that whatever you spend, Allah will replace it.
مَا يُنْفَقُ فِي الصَّدَقَةِ لَا يَضِيعُ.

q: A man said he had never kissed any of his ten children. The Prophet {saw} said: “Whoever does not show mercy…”
قَالَ رَجُلٌ إِنَّهُ لَمْ يُقَبِّلْ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَوْلَادِهِ العَشَرَةِ، فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ {saw}: «مَنْ لاَ يَرْحَمُ ...»
x: He said it right after kissing his grandson: tenderness with children is part of mercy.
قَالَهَا بَعْدَ أَنْ قَبَّلَ حَفِيدَهُ الحَسَنَ {ra}.

q: Complete: “Whoever travels a path seeking knowledge, Allah makes easy for him a path to…”
أكمل: «مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى ...»
x: Every step taken to learn the religion is a step on the road to Paradise.
رَوَاهُ أَبُو هُرَيْرَةَ {ra}.

q: What does Allah do for a person who covers the faults of a Muslim?
مَاذَا يَفْعَلُ اللَّهُ بِمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا؟
o: Covers him in this world and the Hereafter
x: “Whoever covers a Muslim, Allah will cover him in this world and the Hereafter.”
قال {saw}: «وَمَنْ سَتَرَ مُسْلِمًا سَتَرَهُ اللَّهُ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ».

q: Complete: “Allah does not increase a servant who forgives except in…”
أكمل: «وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ ...»
x: Forgiving others can feel like losing face, but in Allah’s sight it is the very opposite.
قال {saw}: «وَمَا زَادَ اللَّهُ عَبْدًا بِعَفْوٍ إِلاَّ عِزًّا».

q: Complete: “And the Quran is a proof…”
أكمل: «وَالْقُرْآنُ حُجَّةٌ ...»
o: on the Day of Judgement only
x: The Quran will speak either for a person or against them, depending on how they lived by it.
قال {saw}: «وَالْقُرْآنُ حُجَّةٌ لَكَ أَوْ عَلَيْكَ».

q: In the hadith of intentions, whose emigration counts only for what he emigrated for?
فِي حَدِيثِ النِّيَّةِ، مَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ فَقَطْ؟
o: The one who emigrated for worldly gain or to marry
The one who emigrated for Allah
The one who emigrated with his family
مَنْ هَاجَرَ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا
x: Two people can do the same act: one for Allah and His Messenger, the other for worldly gain. Each gets only what he intended.
قال {saw}: «فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى دُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوْ إِلَى امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا، فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ».

q: Whoever relieves a believer of a hardship of this world, Allah will relieve him of a hardship of…
مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا، نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ...
x: “Whoever relieves a believer of a hardship of this world, Allah will relieve him of a hardship of the Day of Resurrection.”
قال {saw}: «مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ».

q: Which of these continues to benefit a person after death?
أَيٌّ مِمَّا يَلِي يَبْقَى نَفْعُهُ لِلْإِنْسَانِ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ؟
x: Ongoing charity keeps earning reward long after the giver has died.
«إِلاَّ مِنْ صَدَقَةٍ جَارِيَةٍ أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ».

q: In the hadith of the three things, the righteous child benefits a parent by doing what?
فِي حَدِيثِ الثَّلَاثَةِ، بِمَاذَا يَنْفَعُ الوَلَدُ الصَّالِحُ وَالِدَهُ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهِ؟
x: A child’s prayers keep benefiting parents even after they have passed away.
«أَوْ وَلَدٍ صَالِحٍ يَدْعُو لَهُ».

q: When something good happens to the believer, what does he do, so it is good for him?
إِنْ أَصَابَتِ المُؤْمِنَ سَرَّاءُ فَمَاذَا يَفْعَلُ فَيَكُونُ خَيْرًا لَهُ؟
x: Thanking Allah for a blessing turns the blessing itself into a reward.
«إِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ سَرَّاءُ شَكَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ».

q: When hardship befalls the believer, what does he do, so it is good for him?
إِنْ أَصَابَتِ المُؤْمِنَ ضَرَّاءُ فَمَاذَا يَفْعَلُ فَيَكُونُ خَيْرًا لَهُ؟
x: Even hardship becomes good for the believer when he meets it the right way.
«وَإِنْ أَصَابَتْهُ ضَرَّاءُ صَبَرَ فَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَهُ».

q: According to the hadith, what does lying lead to?
بِحَسَبِ الحَدِيثِ، إِلَى أَيْنَ يَهْدِي الكَذِبُ؟
x: And wickedness leads to the Fire, just as honesty ultimately leads to Paradise.
«وَإِنَّ الْكَذِبَ يَهْدِي إِلَى الْفُجُورِ».

q: In the “one body” hadith, when one part complains, how does the rest of the body respond?
فِي حَدِيثِ الجَسَدِ الوَاحِدِ، إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوٌ فَبِمَاذَا يَتَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ الجَسَدِ؟
x: That is how believers should feel for one another: when one suffers, all feel it.
«إِذَا اشْتَكَى عُضْوًا تَدَاعَى لَهُ سَائِرُ جَسَدِهِ بِالسَّهَرِ وَالْحُمَّى».

q: Whoever fulfils the need of his brother, Allah will fulfil…
مَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ اللَّهُ فِي...
o: his wish in this world only
x: Helping others with their needs brings Allah’s help with yours.
«وَمَنْ كَانَ فِي حَاجَةِ أَخِيهِ كَانَ اللَّهُ فِي حَاجَتِهِ».

q: Whoever guards himself against doubtful matters has protected his religion and his…
مَنِ اتَّقَى المُشَبَّهَاتِ فَقَدِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِينِهِ وَ...
x: Doubtful matters lie between the clearly lawful and the clearly forbidden; staying away from them keeps a person safe.
«فَمَنِ اتَّقَى الْمُشَبَّهَاتِ اسْتَبْرَأَ لِدِيِنِهِ وَعِرْضِهِ».

q: If something befalls you, do not say “if only I had…”, because “if” opens the door to what?
إِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَيْءٌ فَلَا تَقُلْ «لَوْ أَنِّي فَعَلْتُ»، فَإِنَّ «لَوْ» تَفْتَحُ مَاذَا؟
x: Regret over what cannot be changed only lets Shaytan in; the hadith teaches a better response instead.
«فَإِنَّ لَوْ تَفْتَحُ عَمَلَ الشَّيْطَانِ».

q: In the hadith qudsi, if the servant draws near to Allah by a hand’s span, Allah draws near to him by…
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ: إِنْ تَقَرَّبَ العَبْدُ إِلَى اللَّهِ شِبْرًا، تَقَرَّبَ اللَّهُ إِلَيْهِ...
x: The hadith pictures Allah’s generosity: whatever step the servant takes towards Him, Allah’s response is greater.
«وَإِنْ تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ بِشِبْرٍ تَقَرَّبْتُ إِلَيْهِ ذِرَاعًا».

q: In the hadith qudsi, what is the most beloved way for a servant to draw near to Allah?
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ، مَا أَحَبُّ مَا يَتَقَرَّبُ بِهِ العَبْدُ إِلَى اللَّهِ؟
x: Then he keeps drawing near through voluntary deeds until Allah loves him.
«وَمَا تَقَرَّبَ إِلَىَّ عَبْدِي بِشَىْءٍ أَحَبَّ إِلَىَّ مِمَّا افْتَرَضْتُ عَلَيْهِ».

q: In the Hadith of Jibril, the levels of the religion are Islam, Iman and…
ذَكَرَ حَدِيثُ جِبْرِيلَ مَرَاتِبَ الدِّينِ: الإِسْلَامَ وَالإِيمَانَ وَ... فَمَا الثَّالِثَةُ؟
x: Ihsan is to worship Allah as though you see Him, for though you do not see Him, He sees you. Narrated by ʿUmar {ra}.
«أَنْ تَعْبُدَ اللَّهَ كَأَنَّكَ تَرَاهُ فَإِنْ لَمْ تَكُنْ تَرَاهُ فَإِنَّهُ يَرَاكَ». رَوَاهُ عُمَرُ {ra}.

q: Complete: “The religion is…”
أَكْمِلْ: «الدِّينُ ...»
x: When asked “to whom?”, he said: to Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.
قِيلَ: لِمَنْ؟ قَالَ: «لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ».

q: Complete: “Purity is ___ of faith.”
أَكْمِلْ: «الطُّهُورُ ... الإِيمَانِ»
x: The same hadith goes on to the virtues of dhikr, prayer, charity and patience.
وَيُكْمِلُ الحَدِيثُ بِفَضْلِ الذِّكْرِ وَالصَّلَاةِ وَالصَّدَقَةِ وَالصَّبْرِ.

q: Which deeds are most beloved to Allah?
مَا أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ؟
o: The most consistent, even if small
x: He {saw} said: “The most beloved of deeds to Allah are the most constant, even if little.”
قَالَ {saw}: «أَحَبَّ الأَعْمَالِ أَدْوَمُهَا إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَإِنْ قَلَّ».

q: Which two phrases did the Prophet {saw} describe as “beloved to the Most Merciful, light on the tongue, heavy on the Scale”?
مَا الكَلِمَتَانِ اللَّتَانِ قَالَ فِيهِمَا النَّبِيُّ {saw}: «حَبِيبَتَانِ إِلَى الرَّحْمَنِ، خَفِيفَتَانِ عَلَى اللِّسَانِ، ثَقِيلَتَانِ فِي الْمِيزَانِ»؟
o: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ العَظِيمِ
لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ، أَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهَ
x: The final hadith in Sahih al-Bukhari: two short phrases, light on the tongue but heavy on the Scale.
وَهُوَ آخِرُ حَدِيثٍ فِي صَحِيحِ البُخَارِيِّ.

q: “The upper hand is better than the lower hand.” Which is the upper hand?
«الْيَدُ الْعُلْيَا خَيْرٌ مِنَ الْيَدِ السُّفْلَى». مَا اليَدُ العُلْيَا؟
x: He said it from the minbar while speaking about charity and refraining from begging.
قَالَهَا عَلَى المِنْبَرِ وَهُوَ يَذْكُرُ الصَّدَقَةَ وَالتَّعَفُّفَ عَنِ المَسْأَلَةِ.

q: When Jibril asked about the Hour, what did the Prophet {saw} answer?
لَمَّا سَأَلَ جِبْرِيلُ عَنِ السَّاعَةِ، بِمَاذَا أَجَابَ النَّبِيُّ {saw}؟
o: “The one asked knows no more than the one asking.”
“It will come in a hundred years.”
x: Jibril then asked about its signs, and the Prophet {saw} described some of them.
قَالَ {saw}: «مَا الْمَسْئُولُ عَنْهَا بِأَعْلَمَ مِنَ السَّائِلِ».

q: Among the signs of the Hour in the Hadith of Jibril, the barefoot, destitute shepherds compete in what?
مِنْ أَمَارَاتِ السَّاعَةِ فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ أَنَّ الحُفَاةَ العُرَاةَ العَالَةَ رِعَاءَ الشَّاءِ يَتَطَاوَلُونَ فِي...؟
x: “…and that you see the barefoot, naked, destitute shepherds competing in constructing tall buildings.”
قَالَ {saw}: «وَأَنْ تَرَى الْحُفَاةَ الْعُرَاةَ الْعَالَةَ رِعَاءَ الشَّاءِ يَتَطَاوَلُونَ فِي الْبُنْيَانِ».

q: When the qiblah changed, a man passed by people who were praying. What position were they in?
لَمَّا حُوِّلَتِ القِبْلَةُ مَرَّ رَجُلٌ عَلَى قَوْمٍ يُصَلُّونَ، فَعَلَى أَيِّ حَالٍ كَانُوا؟
x: The news reached them mid-prayer, and they turned towards the Kaʿbah right away.
«فَمَرَّ عَلَى أَهْلِ مَسْجِدٍ، وَهُمْ رَاكِعُونَ»، «فَدَارُوا كَمَا هُمْ قِبَلَ الْبَيْتِ».

q: A man heard someone repeating only “Say, He is Allah, the One” all night. What did he think of it?
سَمِعَ رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا يُرَدِّدُ «قُلْ هُوَ اللَّهُ أَحَدٌ» اللَّيْلَ كُلَّهُ، فَمَاذَا ظَنَّ فِيهَا؟
o: That it was the best prayer
That it was a new practice
x: He thought it was little, so the Prophet {saw} said it equals a third of the Quran.
«وَكَأَنَّ الرَّجُلَ يَتَقَالُّهَا»، فَقَالَ {saw}: «إِنَّهَا لَتَعْدِلُ ثُلُثَ الْقُرْآنِ».

q: In “The religion is sincere counsel”, when asked “To whom?”, whom did the Prophet {saw} mention first?
فِي حَدِيثِ «الدِّينُ النَّصِيحَةُ»، لَمَّا قِيلَ: لِمَنْ؟ مَنْ ذَكَرَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} أَوَّلًا؟
x: To Allah, His Book, His Messenger, the leaders of the Muslims and their common people.
قَالَ {saw}: «لِلَّهِ وَلِكِتَابِهِ وَلِرَسُولِهِ وَلأَئِمَّةِ الْمُسْلِمِينَ وَعَامَّتِهِمْ».

q: “In the body there is a piece of flesh; if it is sound, the whole body is sound.” What is it?
«أَلاَ وَإِنَّ فِي الْجَسَدِ مُضْغَةً إِذَا صَلَحَتْ صَلَحَ الْجَسَدُ كُلُّهُ». مَا هِيَ؟
x: It is the heart: when it is sound, the whole body follows.
«أَلاَ وَهِيَ الْقَلْبُ».

q: Ibn ʿUmar {ra} advised: “When evening comes, do not wait for…”
قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ {ra}: «إِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ ...»
x: And when morning comes, do not wait for the evening.
«إِذَا أَمْسَيْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ الصَّبَاحَ، وَإِذَا أَصْبَحْتَ فَلاَ تَنْتَظِرِ الْمَسَاءَ».

q: Ibn ʿUmar {ra} advised: “Take from your health for your…”
قَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ {ra}: «وَخُذْ مِنْ صِحَّتِكَ لِ ...»
x: And from your life for your death.
«وَخُذْ مِنْ صِحَّتِكَ لِمَرَضِكَ، وَمِنْ حَيَاتِكَ لِمَوْتِكَ».

q: In the hadith qudsi, what does Allah say about whoever shows enmity to a close friend (wali) of His?
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ، مَاذَا قَالَ اللَّهُ فِيمَنْ عَادَى لَهُ وَلِيًّا؟
o: I have declared war on him
x: Showing hostility to Allah’s close friends is so serious that Allah Himself declares war.
«مَنْ عَادَى لِي وَلِيًّا فَقَدْ آذَنْتُهُ بِالْحَرْبِ».

q: When Allah loves His servant, He becomes his hearing with which he hears, and his…
إِذَا أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ عَبْدَهُ كَانَ سَمْعَهُ الَّذِي يَسْمَعُ بِهِ وَ...
x: Allah guides every faculty of the servant He loves.
«كُنْتُ سَمْعَهُ الَّذِي يَسْمَعُ بِهِ، وَبَصَرَهُ الَّذِي يُبْصِرُ بِهِ».

q: In the hadith qudsi, if the servant remembers Allah in a gathering, where does Allah remember him?
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ، إِنْ ذَكَرَ العَبْدُ اللَّهَ فِي مَلَأٍ، أَيْنَ يَذْكُرُهُ اللَّهُ؟
o: In a gathering better than it
x: Remember Allah in company, and Allah mentions you in a far better company.
«وَإِنْ ذَكَرَنِي فِي مَلأٍ ذَكَرْتُهُ فِي مَلأٍ خَيْرٍ مِنْهُمْ».

q: When something befalls you, what should you say instead of “if only”?
إِنْ أَصَابَكَ شَيْءٌ فَمَاذَا تَقُولُ بَدَلَ «لَوْ»؟
o: Allah has decreed, and what He wills He does
I will do better next time
x: Accepting Allah’s decree brings peace of heart, instead of endless regret.
«قَدَرُ اللَّهِ وَمَا شَاءَ فَعَلَ».

q: A man keeps telling the truth until he is recorded with Allah as what?
لَا يَزَالُ الرَّجُلُ يَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يُكْتَبَ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ...
x: Truthfulness shapes character: keep choosing it, and it becomes who you are.
«وَإِنَّ الرَّجُلَ لَيَصْدُقُ حَتَّى يَكُونَ صِدِّيقًا».

q: In Sahih al-Bukhari 71, after “Whoever Allah wants good for…”, the Prophet {saw} said: “I am only a distributor, and Allah is the one who…”
فِي صَحِيحِ البُخَارِيِّ 71، قَالَ {saw}: «وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ وَاللَّهُ ...»
x: He described himself only as the one who distributes; the true Giver is Allah.
«وَإِنَّمَا أَنَا قَاسِمٌ وَاللَّهُ يُعْطِي».

q: “Every king has a protected sanctuary.” What is Allah’s sanctuary on His earth?
«أَلاَ وَإِنَّ لِكُلِّ مَلِكٍ حِمًى». مَا حِمَى اللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ؟
x: Every king has a protected area, and Allah’s is what He has forbidden: stay well away from its edges.
«أَلاَ إِنَّ حِمَى اللَّهِ فِي أَرْضِهِ مَحَارِمُهُ».

q: In the Hadith of Jibril, how many pillars of Iman are named?
فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ، كَمْ عَدَدُ أَرْكَانِ الإِيمَانِ المَذْكُورَةِ؟
x: They are matters of belief, beginning with belief in Allah.
الإِيمَانُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَاليَوْمِ الآخِرِ، وَالقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ.

q: Complete: “No one humbles himself for Allah except that Allah…”
أَكْمِلْ: «وَمَا تَوَاضَعَ أَحَدٌ لِلَّهِ إِلاَّ ...»
x: It is the end of the hadith that begins “Charity never decreases wealth.”
هُوَ خِتَامُ الحَدِيثِ الَّذِي أَوَّلُهُ: «مَا نَقَصَتْ صَدَقَةٌ مِنْ مَالٍ».

q: In the hadith “Purity is half of faith”, what is prayer described as?
فِي حَدِيثِ «الطُّهُورُ شَطْرُ الإِيمَانِ»، بِمَاذَا وُصِفَتِ الصَّلَاةُ؟
x: The same hadith describes charity as proof, and patience as brightness.
«وَالصَّلاَةُ نُورٌ وَالصَّدَقَةُ بُرْهَانٌ وَالصَّبْرُ ضِيَاءٌ».

q: In the hadith listing everyday good deeds, what is every step taken towards the prayer described as?
فِي الحَدِيثِ الَّذِي عَدَّدَ أَعْمَالَ الخَيْرِ اليَوْمِيَّةَ، بِمَاذَا وُصِفَتْ كُلُّ خُطْوَةٍ يَمْشِيهَا المَرْءُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ؟
x: The same hadith counts a good word and removing harm from the road as charity too.
وَعَدَّ الحَدِيثُ نَفْسُهُ الكَلِمَةَ الطَّيِّبَةَ وَإِمَاطَةَ الأَذَى عَنِ الطَّرِيقِ صَدَقَةً.

q: Complete: “Whoever makes things easy for one in difficulty, Allah will make things easy for him…”
أَكْمِلْ: «وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ …»
o: in this world and the Hereafter
on the Day of Judgement only
x: From the same hadith as “Allah helps the servant as long as he helps his brother”.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَمَنْ يَسَّرَ عَلَى مُعْسِرٍ يَسَّرَ اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ».

q: Complete: “Whoever is held back by his deeds will not be hastened forward by his…”
أَكْمِلْ: «وَمَنْ بَطَّأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ …»
x: Nobility of family does not make up for a lack of good deeds.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَمَنْ بَطَّأَ بِهِ عَمَلُهُ لَمْ يُسْرِعْ بِهِ نَسَبُهُ».

q: When people gather in a house of Allah to recite and study His Book, what descends upon them first, as the hadith lists?
إِذَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ، فَمَا أَوَّلُ مَا ذَكَرَ الحَدِيثُ أَنَّهُ يَنْزِلُ عَلَيْهِمْ؟
x: Tranquillity descends, mercy covers them, the angels surround them, and Allah mentions them among those with Him.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَمَا اجْتَمَعَ قَوْمٌ فِي بَيْتٍ مِنْ بُيُوتِ اللَّهِ يَتْلُونَ كِتَابَ اللَّهِ وَيَتَدَارَسُونَهُ بَيْنَهُمْ إِلاَّ نَزَلَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ السَّكِينَةُ».

q: Complete the Prophet’s {saw} words: “Be moderate and draw near, and know that…”
أَكْمِلْ قَوْلَهُ {saw}: «سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنْ …»
o: no one’s deeds alone will admit him to Paradise
the reward is doubled on Fridays
x: Entry to Paradise is by Allah’s mercy; the same hadith adds that the most beloved deeds are the most constant, even if little.
قَالَ {saw}: «سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا، وَاعْلَمُوا أَنْ لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدَكُمْ عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ».

q: In the Hadith of Jibril, how is the stranger who came described?
فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ، كَيْفَ وُصِفَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي طَلَعَ عَلَيْهِمْ؟
o: Very white clothes and very black hair
An old man with a white beard
شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعَرِ
x: No sign of travel was seen on him, and none of them knew him.
«شَدِيدُ بَيَاضِ الثِّيَابِ شَدِيدُ سَوَادِ الشَّعَرِ لاَ يُرَى عَلَيْهِ أَثَرُ السَّفَرِ».

q: In the Hadith of Jibril, how did the stranger sit before the Prophet {saw}?
فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ، كَيْفَ جَلَسَ الرَّجُلُ أَمَامَ النَّبِيِّ {saw}؟
o: Knees to his knees, palms on his thighs
أَسْنَدَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ
x: He sat close, as a student sits before a teacher, before asking his questions.
«فَأَسْنَدَ رُكْبَتَيْهِ إِلَى رُكْبَتَيْهِ وَوَضَعَ كَفَّيْهِ عَلَى فَخِذَيْهِ».

q: When the Prophet {saw} told Ibn ʿUmar “Be in this world as though you were a stranger”, what did he take hold of?
حِينَ قَالَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} لِابْنِ عُمَرَ «كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ»، بِمَاذَا أَخَذَ؟
x: He took Ibn ʿUmar {ra} by the shoulder, a gesture of closeness, as he gave the advice.
«أَخَذَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَنْكِبِي».

q: In the hadith qudsi, when Allah loves His servant, He becomes his hand with which he strikes and his foot with which he…
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ: إِذَا أَحَبَّ اللَّهُ عَبْدَهُ كَانَ يَدَهُ الَّتِي يَبْطُشُ بِهَا وَرِجْلَهُ الَّتِي...
x: Everything such a servant does is guided by the One who loves him.
«وَيَدَهُ الَّتِي يَبْطُشُ بِهَا وَرِجْلَهُ الَّتِي يَمْشِي بِهَا».

q: In the hadith qudsi, what does Allah say if the servant He loves asks Him?
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ، مَاذَا قَالَ اللَّهُ إِنْ سَأَلَهُ عَبْدُهُ الَّذِي أَحَبَّهُ؟
x: And if he seeks refuge in Me, I will surely grant him refuge.
«وَإِنْ سَأَلَنِي لأُعْطِيَنَّهُ، وَلَئِنِ اسْتَعَاذَنِي لأُعِيذَنَّهُ».

q: In the hadith qudsi, if the servant comes to Allah walking, how does Allah come to him?
فِي الحَدِيثِ القُدْسِيِّ، إِنْ أَتَى العَبْدُ إِلَى اللَّهِ يَمْشِي، كَيْفَ يَأْتِيهِ اللَّهُ؟
x: The hadith pictures Allah’s generosity: whatever effort the servant makes towards Him, Allah’s response is greater.
«وَإِنْ أَتَانِي يَمْشِي أَتَيْتُهُ هَرْوَلَةً».

q: Whoever falls into doubtful matters is like a shepherd grazing around a sanctuary, about to…
مَنْ وَقَعَ فِي الشُّبُهَاتِ كَرَاعٍ يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الحِمَى يُوشِكُ أَنْ...
x: Whoever keeps going near the edge of what is forbidden may end up falling in.
«كَرَاعٍ يَرْعَى حَوْلَ الْحِمَى، يُوشِكُ أَنْ يُوَاقِعَهُ».

q: After “Be keen on what benefits you and seek help from Allah”, what did the Prophet {saw} say?
بَعْدَ «احْرِصْ عَلَى مَا يَنْفَعُكَ وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ»، مَاذَا قَالَ النَّبِيُّ {saw}؟
o: And do not give up (la taʿjiz)
x: Effort, reliance on Allah and persistence go together in this hadith.
«وَاسْتَعِنْ بِاللَّهِ وَلاَ تَعْجِزْ».

q: The believer’s affair is all good. For whom else is this true?
أَمْرُ المُؤْمِنِ كُلُّهُ خَيْرٌ. لِمَنْ غَيْرِهِ يَكُونُ ذَلِكَ؟
o: For no one except the believer
x: Whatever happens to the believer, ease or hardship, can become good for him.
«وَلَيْسَ ذَاكَ لأَحَدٍ إِلاَّ لِلْمُؤْمِنِ».

q: Among the three things that continue after death is knowledge that is…
مِنَ الثَّلَاثَةِ الَّتِي لَا يَنْقَطِعُ أَجْرُهَا بَعْدَ المَوْتِ: عِلْمٌ...
x: Teaching others something beneficial keeps earning reward long after you are gone.
«أَوْ عِلْمٍ يُنْتَفَعُ بِهِ».

q: In the hadith of the wali, what does Allah say the believer dislikes?
فِي حَدِيثِ الوَلِيِّ، مَاذَا قَالَ اللَّهُ إِنَّ المُؤْمِنَ يَكْرَهُهُ؟
x: Allah dislikes hurting the believer, even at death.
«يَكْرَهُ الْمَوْتَ وَأَنَا أَكْرَهُ مَسَاءَتَهُ».

q: In the Prophet’s {saw} parable, the believer who recites the Quran is like which fruit, good in taste and good in scent?
فِي مَثَلِ النَّبِيِّ {saw}، المُؤْمِنُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ كَأَيِّ ثَمَرَةٍ، طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ؟
x: The one who does not recite is like a date: sweet, but without scent.
قَالَ {saw}: «مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَالأُتْرُجَّةِ طَعْمُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَرِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ».

q: In the same parable, the wicked person who recites the Quran is like which plant: pleasant scent, bitter taste?
فِي المَثَلِ نَفْسِهِ، الفَاجِرُ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ القُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ أَيِّ نَبْتَةٍ، رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ؟
x: And the wicked person who does not recite is like the colocynth: bitter, with no scent at all.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَمَثَلُ الْفَاجِرِ الَّذِي يَقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ كَمَثَلِ الرَّيْحَانَةِ رِيحُهَا طَيِّبٌ وَطَعْمُهَا مُرٌّ».

q: The Prophet {saw} likened a good companion to someone carrying musk. What did he liken a bad companion to?
شَبَّهَ النَّبِيُّ {saw} الجَلِيسَ الصَّالِحَ بِحَامِلِ المِسْكِ، فَبِمَاذَا شَبَّهَ جَلِيسَ السُّوءِ؟
x: With the musk-carrier you gain either way: a gift, a purchase, or at least a pleasant scent. The bellows may burn your clothes, or at least leave you with a foul smell.
قَالَ {saw}: «وَنَافِخُ الْكِيرِ إِمَّا أَنْ يُحْرِقَ ثِيَابَكَ، وَإِمَّا أَنْ تَجِدَ رِيحًا خَبِيثَةً».

q: The Prophet {saw} said the one who remembers his Lord, compared with the one who does not, is like…
قَالَ النَّبِيُّ {saw}: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لَا يَذْكُرُ مَثَلُ...
x: A short hadith with a big meaning: remembering Allah is what keeps the heart alive.
قَالَ {saw}: «مَثَلُ الَّذِي يَذْكُرُ رَبَّهُ وَالَّذِي لاَ يَذْكُرُ مَثَلُ الْحَىِّ وَالْمَيِّتِ».

q: Complete: “Paradise is closer to each of you than the strap of his…”
أَكْمِلْ: «الْجَنَّةُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ شِرَاكِ...»
x: The hadith continues: “and the Fire is just the same.” Both are only a few deeds away.
قَالَ {saw}: «الْجَنَّةُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى أَحَدِكُمْ مِنْ شِرَاكِ نَعْلِهِ، وَالنَّارُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ».

q: Which of these is one of the pillars of Iman named in the Hadith of Jibril?
أَيٌّ مِمَّا يَلِي مِنْ أَرْكَانِ الإِيمَانِ المَذْكُورَةِ فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ؟
x: Fasting, zakah and Hajj are pillars of Islam. The pillars of Iman, as listed in the Hadith of Jibril, are matters of belief: in Allah, His angels, and more.
الصَّوْمُ وَالزَّكَاةُ وَالحَجُّ مِنْ أَرْكَانِ الإِسْلَامِ، أَمَّا أَرْكَانُ الإِيمَانِ فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ فَأُمُورٌ اعْتِقَادِيَّةٌ، مِنْهَا الإِيمَانُ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ.

q: For what purpose did Allah create jinn and mankind?
لِمَاذَا خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الجِنَّ وَالإِنْسَ؟
x: The next verse makes clear that Allah needs nothing from them: He wants no provision from them, nor that they feed Him.

q: Complete: ﴾There is nothing like…﴿
x: The verse pairs this with ﴾and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing﴿: Allah hears and sees everything, yet nothing in creation is like Him.

q: In Ayat al-Kursi, which two names of Allah follow ﴾there is no god but Him﴿?
فِي آيَةِ الكُرْسِيِّ، مَا الاِسْمَانِ اللَّذَانِ يَأْتِيَانِ بَعْدَ {Q:2:255:2-5}؟
o: The Most Merciful, the Most Kind
x: Ayat al-Kursi opens with these two names: the Ever-Living, and the Sustainer of all that exists. The rest of the verse unfolds what they mean.

q: Complete: ﴾And your god is one…﴿
x: The verse describes Allah right away through His mercy: ﴾there is no god but Him, the Most Merciful, the Especially Merciful﴿.

q: In Surah Al-Fatihah, Allah is Master of which day?
فِي سُورَةِ الفَاتِحَةِ، اللَّهُ مَالِكُ أَيِّ يَوْمٍ؟
x: On that Day every soul is repaid for what it did, and Allah alone is its Sovereign. Muslims affirm this every time they recite Al-Fatihah.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:1:4}.

q: According to the end of Surah Al-Baqarah, the believers believe in Allah, His angels, His Books and His…
بِحَسَبِ خَاتِمَةِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، آمَنَ المُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَ...
x: The believers add that they make no distinction between any of Allah’s messengers, and say: ﴾We hear and we obey﴿.

q: Complete: ﴾He is the First and the…﴿
x: The First, with nothing before Him; the Last, with nothing after Him. The verse continues: the Manifest and the Hidden, Knower of all things.

q: According to Surah Al-Anʿam, who alone holds the keys of the unseen?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَنْعَامِ، عِنْدَ مَنْ مَفَاتِحُ الغَيْبِ؟
x: He knows everything on land and sea: not a leaf falls without His knowledge, nor a grain in the darkness of the earth.

q: According to Ayat al-Kursi, what never overtakes Allah?
بِحَسَبِ آيَةِ الكُرْسِيِّ، مَا الَّذِي لَا يَأْخُذُ اللَّهَ أَبَدًا؟
x: Allah never tires and never loses track of anything: all that is in the heavens and on earth belongs to Him.

q: From what did Allah create the jinn?
مِمَّ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ الجَانَّ؟
x: Allah created the jinn from fire, while Adam was created from clay: two different creations.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:55:15}، أَمَّا آدَمُ فَخُلِقَ مِنْ طِينٍ.

q: From what did Allah create Adam {as}, according to Surah Al ʿImran?
مِمَّ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ آدَمَ {as} بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ؟
x: Then He said to him ﴾Be﴿, and he was.

q: According to Surah Al-Israʾ, does Allah have a partner in His dominion?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ، هَلْ لِلَّهِ شَرِيكٌ فِي المُلْكِ؟
x: The verse commands praising Allah, who has no son, no partner in His dominion, and no protector out of weakness.

q: According to Surah Fatir, is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the sky and the earth?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ فَاطِرٍ، هَلْ مِنْ خَالِقٍ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ يَرْزُقُكُمْ مِنَ السَّمَاءِ وَالأَرْضِ؟
o: No; there is no god but Him
x: Allah asks it as a challenge, then answers it: there is no god but Him, so how are you turned away?

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, who created for us everything on the earth?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَنْ خَلَقَ لَنَا مَا فِي الأَرْضِ جَمِيعًا؟
x: Everything on earth was created for our benefit, a reason to be grateful to the One who made it.

q: In the Hadith of Jibril, what is the last pillar of Iman mentioned?
فِي حَدِيثِ جِبْرِيلَ، مَا آخِرُ أَرْكَانِ الإِيمَانِ ذِكْرًا؟
o: Belief in qadar, its good and its bad
x: The hadith ends the list with belief in qadar, its good and its bad.
«وَتُؤْمِنَ بِالْقَدَرِ خَيْرِهِ وَشَرِّهِ».

q: According to Surah An-Nisaʾ, what does Allah not forgive, while forgiving what is less than it for whom He wills?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ، مَا الَّذِي لَا يَغْفِرُهُ اللَّهُ، وَيَغْفِرُ مَا دُونَهُ لِمَنْ يَشَاءُ؟
x: This refers to a person who dies upon associating partners with Allah.

q: Allah says He is closer to a person than his…
يَقُولُ اللَّهُ إِنَّهُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى الإِنْسَانِ مِنْ...
x: Allah even knows what a person’s soul whispers to him.

q: According to Surah An-Naml, who in the heavens and the earth knows the unseen?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ النَّمْلِ، مَنْ يَعْلَمُ الغَيْبَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ؟
x: ﴾Say: none in the heavens and the earth knows the unseen except Allah.﴿

q: ﴾Everyone upon the earth will perish, and there will remain the Face of your Lord﴿ is in which surah?
x: Everything will perish except Allah. The surah keeps returning to one question: which of your Lord’s favours will you deny?
سُورَةُ الرَّحْمَنِ، الآيَتَانِ 26 وَ27.

q: What does Surah Al-Aʿraf say belongs to Allah, so call upon Him by them?
مَاذَا قَالَتْ سُورَةُ الأَعْرَافِ إِنَّهُ لِلَّهِ فَادْعُوهُ بِهَا؟
x: The same verse warns: leave those who distort His names.

q: According to Surah Fatir, people are all in need of Allah, while Allah is…
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ فَاطِرٍ، النَّاسُ فُقَرَاءُ إِلَى اللَّهِ، وَاللَّهُ هُوَ...
x: All creation needs Allah for everything, while He needs nothing and is praised for all He does.

q: According to Surah Al-Anbiyaʾ, what would happen if there were gods in the heavens and earth besides Allah?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، مَاذَا لَوْ كَانَ فِي السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ آلِهَةٌ غَيْرُ اللَّهِ؟
x: Exalted is Allah, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.

q: According to Surah Al-Anʿam, what are eyes unable to do?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَنْعَامِ، مَاذَا لَا تَسْتَطِيعُ الأَبْصَارُ؟
x: He is the Subtle, the All-Aware: no eye can grasp Him, yet He sees all.

q: Complete: ﴾Say: O Allah, Owner of…﴿
x: You give sovereignty to whom You will and take it from whom You will.

q: In Surah An-Nahl, Allah says: do not take two gods; He is only…
فِي سُورَةِ النَّحْلِ، يَقُولُ اللَّهُ: لَا تَتَّخِذُوا إِلَهَيْنِ اثْنَيْنِ، إِنَّمَا هُوَ...
x: The verse continues: so fear Me alone.

q: Which two angels are named in Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 98?
مَا المَلَكَانِ المَذْكُورَانِ بِاسْمَيْهِمَا فِي الآيَةِ 98 مِنْ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ؟
x: The verse warns that whoever is an enemy to Allah, His angels and messengers, and to Jibril and Mikal, Allah is an enemy to the disbelievers.

q: How does Surah At-Tahrim describe the angels over the Fire?
كَيْفَ وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ التَّحْرِيمِ المَلَائِكَةَ الَّذِينَ عَلَى النَّارِ؟
o: Harsh and severe; they never disobey Allah
x: The same verse commands: protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones.

q: According to Surah Qaf, where are the two recording angels seated?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ ق، أَيْنَ يَقْعُدُ المُتَلَقِّيَانِ؟
o: On the right and on the left
x: The next verse adds: a person utters no word except that a watcher is ready beside him.

q: How does Surah Al-Infitar describe the guardians appointed over people?
بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ الاِنْفِطَارِ الحَافِظِينَ عَلَى النَّاسِ؟
x: The next verse adds: they know whatever you do.

q: According to Surah As-Sajdah, who takes the souls at death?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ السَّجْدَةِ، مَنْ يَتَوَفَّى الأَنْفُسَ؟
x: ﴾Say: the angel of death, who has been entrusted with you, will take you.﴿

q: Surah An-Nisaʾ, verse 136, warns against disbelieving in Allah and how many other things?
تُحَذِّرُ الآيَةُ 136 مِنْ سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ مِنَ الكُفْرِ بِاللَّهِ وَبِكَمْ أَمْرًا آخَرَ؟
o: Four: His angels, Books, messengers and the Last Day
أَرْبَعَةٍ: مَلَائِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ وَاليَوْمِ الآخِرِ
x: The same verse calls the believers to believe in Allah, His Messenger and the Book He sent down.

q: According to Surah Al-Hadid, where is every calamity before Allah brings it into being?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الحَدِيدِ، أَيْنَ كُلُّ مُصِيبَةٍ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَبْرَأَهَا اللَّهُ؟
x: The next verse explains why: so you do not despair over what you missed, nor exult over what you were given.

q: Complete: ﴾Say: nothing will ever befall us except what Allah has…﴿
x: He is our Protector, and upon Allah let the believers rely.

q: What will Allah set up for the Day of Resurrection, according to Surah Al-Anbiyaʾ?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَنْبِيَاءِ، مَاذَا يَضَعُ اللَّهُ لِيَوْمِ القِيَامَةِ؟
x: Even a mustard seed’s weight will be brought forth.

q: According to Surah Ya-Sin, what will be blown, after which people hasten from their graves to their Lord?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ يس، مَاذَا يُنْفَخُ فِيهِ فَإِذَا النَّاسُ مِنَ الأَجْدَاثِ إِلَى رَبِّهِمْ يَنْسِلُونَ؟
o: A trumpet of the angels of war
x: They will ask who raised them from their sleeping place, and be told: this is what the Most Merciful promised.

q: Complete: ﴾Indeed, the religion in the sight of Allah is…﴿
x: The same surah says whoever seeks a religion other than Islam, it will not be accepted from him.

q: According to Ayat al-Kursi, what of Allah’s extends over the heavens and the earth?
بِحَسَبِ آيَةِ الكُرْسِيِّ، مَا الَّذِي وَسِعَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ؟
x: The verse ends: preserving them does not tire Him, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.

q: In Surah Al-Hashr, which name comes right after ﴾the King﴿?
فِي سُورَةِ الحَشْرِ، مَا الاِسْمُ الَّذِي جَاءَ بَعْدَ «الملك» مُبَاشَرَةً؟
x: The verse lists many of Allah’s names together: the King, the Holy, the Peace, the Giver of security.

q: Complete: ﴾He is Allah, the Creator, the Inventor, the…﴿
x: The verse ends: all in the heavens and the earth glorify Him, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.

q: According to Surah Al-Anʿam, how could Allah have a child when He has no…
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَنْعَامِ، أَنَّى يَكُونُ لِلَّهِ وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ تَكُنْ لَهُ...
x: He is the Originator of the heavens and the earth, and He created all things.

q: According to Surah Qaf, what did not touch Allah after He created the heavens and the earth?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ ق، مَا الَّذِي لَمْ يَمَسَّ اللَّهَ بَعْدَ خَلْقِ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ؟
x: Allah’s power is complete: creating all things does not weary Him in the least.

q: According to Surah An-Nahl, what message did every messenger bring to his nation?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ النَّحْلِ، مَا الرِّسَالَةُ الَّتِي بُعِثَ بِهَا كُلُّ رَسُولٍ إِلَى أُمَّتِهِ؟
o: Worship Allah and avoid false gods
x: Every messenger carried the same core message to his own nation.

q: According to Surah Ghafir, has Allah told the Prophet {saw} the stories of all the messengers?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ غَافِرٍ، هَلْ قَصَّ اللَّهُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ {saw} أَخْبَارَ جَمِيعِ الرُّسُلِ؟
o: No; some He told, and some He did not
لَا، مِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَصَّ وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ لَمْ يَقْصُصْ
x: Many messengers came whose stories we have not been told, and every one of them came with Allah’s permission.

q: At the end of Surah Al-Baqarah, what do the believers say about Allah’s messengers?
فِي خَاتِمَةِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَاذَا يَقُولُ المُؤْمِنُونَ عَنْ رُسُلِ اللَّهِ؟
o: We make no distinction between any of them
لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِنْ رُسُلِهِ
x: The believers respond: we hear and we obey; we seek Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the return.

q: According to Surah Al-Muʾminun, did Allah create people without purpose?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المُؤْمِنُونَ، هَلْ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ النَّاسَ عَبَثًا؟
o: No; and they will be returned to Him
x: ﴾Did you think We created you in vain, and that you would not be returned to Us?﴿

q: On the Day of Judgement, what will each person be told to read, according to Surah Al-Israʾ?
يَوْمَ القِيَامَةِ، مَاذَا يُقَالُ لِكُلِّ إِنْسَانٍ أَنْ يَقْرَأَ بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ؟
x: ﴾Read your record. Sufficient is yourself against you this Day as an accountant.﴿

q: In Surah Al-Kahf, what do the wrongdoers say about the record of their deeds?
فِي سُورَةِ الكَهْفِ، مَاذَا يَقُولُ المُجْرِمُونَ عَنْ كِتَابِ أَعْمَالِهِمْ؟
o: It leaves nothing small or great unrecorded
لَا يُغَادِرُ صَغِيرَةً وَلَا كَبِيرَةً إِلَّا أَحْصَاهَا
x: And they will find what they did present, and your Lord wrongs no one.

q: According to Ayat al-Kursi, who can intercede with Allah?
بِحَسَبِ آيَةِ الكُرْسِيِّ، مَنْ يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَ اللَّهِ؟
o: No one, except by His permission
x: No one can intercede with Allah without His permission, however great they are.

q: According to Surah Al-Aʿraf, in how many days did Allah create the heavens and the earth?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَعْرَافِ، فِي كَمْ يَوْمٍ خَلَقَ اللَّهُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالأَرْضَ؟
x: The verse continues: then He rose over the Throne.

q: According to Surah At-Talaq, how many heavens did Allah create, and of the earth the like of them?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الطَّلَاقِ، كَمْ سَمَاءً خَلَقَ اللَّهُ وَمِنَ الأَرْضِ مِثْلَهُنَّ؟
x: The verse explains why: so you may know that Allah has power over all things, and encompasses all things in knowledge.

q: According to Surah Al-Haqqah, how many will carry the Throne of your Lord above them on that Day?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الحَاقَّةِ، كَمْ يَحْمِلُ عَرْشَ رَبِّكَ فَوْقَهُمْ يَوْمَئِذٍ؟
x: The Quran describes the Day of Judgement vividly: the Throne of your Lord borne above them.

q: According to Surah Al-Muddaththir, how many are appointed over Saqar?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المُدَّثِّرِ، كَمْ عَلَيْهَا (سَقَرَ) مِنَ المَلَائِكَةِ؟
x: The number was given as a test for the disbelievers, and to increase the believers in faith.

q: According to Surah Al-Maʿarij, the angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day whose measure is how long?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَعَارِجِ، تَعْرُجُ المَلَائِكَةُ وَالرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِي يَوْمٍ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُ كَمْ؟
x: The verse describes the angels and the Spirit ascending to Allah on a Day of immense length.

q: According to Surah Al-Hajj, a day with your Lord is like how long of what you count?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الحَجِّ، إِنَّ يَوْمًا عِنْدَ رَبِّكَ كَمْ مِمَّا تَعُدُّونَ؟
x: People urged the punishment to come quickly, but Allah never fails His promise.

q: Which two angels in Babylon are named in Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 102?
مَا المَلَكَانِ بِبَابِلَ المَذْكُورَانِ فِي الآيَةِ 102 مِنْ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ؟
x: They would not teach anyone without first warning: we are only a trial.

q: How does Surah Fatir describe the wings of the angels?
بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ فَاطِرٍ أَجْنِحَةَ المَلَائِكَةِ؟
x: He increases in creation what He wills. Allah is over all things capable.

q: According to Surah Az-Zumar, how many times is the Horn blown?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الزُّمَرِ، كَمْ مَرَّةً يُنْفَخُ فِي الصُّورِ؟
x: At the first all fall unconscious except whom Allah wills; at the second they stand, looking on.

q: Complete: ﴾There is nothing except that it glorifies Allah with His praise, but you do not understand their…﴿
x: The seven heavens, the earth and all in them glorify Allah, though we do not understand how.

q: In the hadith “Islam is built on five”, which pillar is mentioned first?
فِي حَدِيثِ «بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ»، مَا أَوَّلُ رُكْنٍ ذُكِرَ؟
x: The testimony that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah.
«شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا رَسُولُ اللَّهِ».

q: According to Surah Al-Maʾidah, what is the first thing washed in wudu?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ، مَا أَوَّلُ مَا يُغْسَلُ فِي الوُضُوءِ؟
x: Wudu comes straight from the Quran: this verse lays out its steps, starting with the face.

q: In which month is fasting prescribed for the believers?
فِي أَيِّ شَهْرٍ فُرِضَ الصِّيَامُ عَلَى المُؤْمِنِينَ؟
x: Fasting was prescribed for the believers as it was for those before them, so that they may become mindful of Allah.

q: According to Surah Al ʿImran, upon whom is the pilgrimage to the House obligatory?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، عَلَى مَنْ يَجِبُ حَجُّ البَيْتِ؟
o: Whoever is able to find a way to it
x: Being able to make the journey is the condition. The verse ends: whoever disbelieves, Allah is free of need of all the worlds.

q: When the call is made for the Friday prayer, what does Allah tell the believers to leave?
إِذَا نُودِيَ لِلصَّلَاةِ يَوْمَ الجُمُعَةِ، مَاذَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ المُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْ يَذَرُوا؟
x: Friday has its own prayer, and when its call is made, business stops for the remembrance of Allah.

q: What does Surah Al-Baqarah command the believers to guard strictly?
مَاذَا أَمَرَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ المُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْ يُحَافِظُوا عَلَيْهِ؟
x: The verse singles out the middle prayer, and ends: ﴾stand before Allah devoutly﴿.

q: Which prophet was commanded to proclaim the Hajj to mankind?
أَيُّ نَبِيٍّ أُمِرَ أَنْ يُؤَذِّنَ فِي النَّاسِ بِالحَجِّ؟
x: Ibrahim called, and people answered: on foot and on every lean camel, from every distant path, to witness benefits for themselves.
قَالَ تَعَالَى لِإِبْرَاهِيمَ: {Q:22:27:1-4}.

q: Complete: ﴾And complete the Hajj and the … for Allah.﴿
x: This verse opens the Quran’s rules of pilgrimage: complete both the Hajj and the ʿUmrah for Allah’s sake.

q: Surah At-Tawbah lists who may receive zakah. Who are named first?
عَدَّدَتْ سُورَةُ التَّوْبَةِ أَهْلَ الزَّكَاةِ. مَنْ ذُكِرَ أَوَّلًا؟
x: The verse lists all who may receive zakah, and calls this distribution ﴾an obligation from Allah﴿.

q: At the Kaʿbah, what does Allah say to take as a place of prayer?
مَاذَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ أَنْ يُتَّخَذَ مُصَلًّى عِنْدَ البَيْتِ؟
x: Allah made the House a place people return to, and a place of safety. He charged Ibrahim and Ismaʿil to purify it for those who worship there.

q: According to Surah Al-Israʾ, which recitation is witnessed?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الإِسْرَاءِ، أَيُّ قُرْآنٍ كَانَ مَشْهُودًا؟
x: The verse sets the prayers from the sun’s decline to the darkness of night, then singles out the dawn recitation as witnessed.

q: Complete Surah Al-Kawthar: ﴾So pray to your Lord and…﴿
x: Prayer and sacrifice together: the surah’s answer to Allah’s great gift of al-Kawthar.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, whatever good you send ahead for yourselves, you will find it…
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَا تُقَدِّمُوا لِأَنْفُسِكُمْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ تَجِدُوهُ...
x: Prayer, zakah and every good deed are stored safely with Allah, and the verse ends: Allah sees all that you do.

q: According to Surah At-Tawbah, who truly maintains the mosques of Allah?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ، مَنْ يَعْمُرُ مَسَاجِدَ اللَّهِ؟
o: Those who believe, pray and give zakah
مَنْ آمَنَ وَأَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ وَآتَى الزَّكَاةَ
x: Maintaining mosques is more than building them: it means faith, prayer, zakah, and fearing none but Allah.

q: When asked what they should spend, who does Surah Al-Baqarah name first?
لَمَّا سَأَلُوا مَاذَا يُنْفِقُونَ، مَنْ ذَكَرَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ أَوَّلًا؟
x: Then relatives, orphans, the needy and the traveller.

q: Complete: ﴾And fasting is better for you, if…﴿
x: It is prescribed for a limited number of days, and whoever volunteers extra good, it is better for him.

q: Surah Al-Hajj commands the believers: ﴾Bow and…﴿
أَمَرَتْ سُورَةُ الحَجِّ المُؤْمِنِينَ: {Q:22:77:4} وَ...
x: ﴾…and worship your Lord and do good, so that you may succeed.﴿

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, until when is the fast completed each day?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، إِلَى مَتَى يُتِمُّ الصَّائِمُ صِيَامَهُ كُلَّ يَوْمٍ؟
x: The fast lasts all day, until nightfall, when Muslims break it.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, eating and drinking are allowed at night until what becomes distinct?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، يَجُوزُ الأَكْلُ وَالشُّرْبُ لَيْلًا حَتَّى يَتَبَيَّنَ مَاذَا؟
o: The white thread from the black thread of dawn
الخَيْطُ الأَبْيَضُ مِنَ الخَيْطِ الأَسْوَدِ مِنَ الفَجْرِ
x: In other words, dawn: once the first light separates from the darkness, the fast begins.

q: According to Surah Al-Maʾidah, if no water can be found for purification, what should one do?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ، إِذَا لَمْ يَجِدِ المَرْءُ مَاءً لِلطَّهَارَةِ فَمَاذَا يَفْعَلُ؟
x: ﴾…and you find no water, then seek clean earth and wipe your faces and hands with it.﴿

q: According to Surah Al-Maʾidah, in wudu the hands are washed up to where?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ، إِلَى أَيْنَ تُغْسَلُ اليَدَانِ فِي الوُضُوءِ؟
x: The arms are washed right up to the elbows, not just the hands.

q: In Surah Al-Baqarah, Allah commands establishing prayer together with what?
فِي سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَاذَا أَمَرَ اللَّهُ مَعَ إِقَامَةِ الصَّلَاةِ؟
x: Prayer and zakah appear side by side many times in the Quran: worship of Allah, paired with care for people.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, what does a sick person or traveller do about missed fasts?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَاذَا يَفْعَلُ المَرِيضُ أَوِ المُسَافِرُ بِالأَيَّامِ الَّتِي أَفْطَرَهَا؟
o: Makes up the same number of other days
x: Even a missed fast can still be completed, just on other days.

q: Complete: ﴾Hajj is during well-known…﴿
x: The verse continues: take provisions for the journey, but the best provision is taqwa.

q: Which two hills does Surah Al-Baqarah call among the symbols of Allah?
مَا الجَبَلَانِ اللَّذَانِ عَدَّتْهُمَا سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ مِنْ شَعَائِرِ اللَّهِ؟
x: Pilgrims walk between these two hills, and Allah says there is no blame in doing so.

q: After the Friday prayer is concluded, what does Surah Al-Jumuʿah allow?
بَعْدَ انْقِضَاءِ صَلَاةِ الجُمُعَةِ، مَاذَا أَبَاحَتْ سُورَةُ الجُمُعَةِ؟
o: Dispersing in the land and seeking Allah’s bounty
الاِنْتِشَارَ فِي الأَرْضِ وَابْتِغَاءَ فَضْلِ اللَّهِ
x: …and remember Allah often, so that you may succeed.

q: How does Surah An-Nisaʾ describe prayer’s obligation on the believers?
كَيْفَ وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ النِّسَاءِ فَرْضَ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى المُؤْمِنِينَ؟
x: Each prayer has its own time, set by Allah.

q: According to Surah At-Tawbah, what does charity taken from people’s wealth do for them?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ، مَاذَا تَفْعَلُ الصَّدَقَةُ المَأْخُوذَةُ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ بِهِمْ؟
o: Purifies them and causes them to grow
x: Zakah is more than a tax: the verse says it purifies the giver, and the Prophet’s {saw} prayer for them brings them peace.

q: According to Surah An-Nisaʾ, what is there no blame in when travelling in the land?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ، مَا الَّذِي لَا جُنَاحَ فِيهِ إِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي الأَرْضِ؟
o: Eating in Ramadan without making it up
x: Shortening the prayer is a mercy that makes worship easier on the road.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, if you are in fear, how may you pray?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، إِذَا خِفْتُمْ فَكَيْفَ تُصَلُّونَ؟
x: Once safe, remember Allah as He taught you.

q: During Hajj, what does Surah Al-Baqarah say there is no blame in seeking?
أَثْنَاءَ الحَجِّ، مَا الَّذِي قَالَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ إِنَّهُ لَا جُنَاحَ فِي ابْتِغَائِهِ؟
x: Trade during the Hajj season is allowed: worship and earning a living can go together.

q: After departing from ʿArafat, where does Surah Al-Baqarah say to remember Allah?
بَعْدَ الإِفَاضَةِ مِنْ عَرَفَاتٍ، أَيْنَ أَمَرَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ بِذِكْرِ اللَّهِ؟
x: That is at Muzdalifah, and the verse adds: remember Him as He has guided you.

q: During the counted days of remembrance, whoever hastens to leave in how many days has no sin?
فِي الأَيَّامِ المَعْدُودَاتِ، مَنْ تَعَجَّلَ فِي كَمْ يَوْمٍ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ؟
x: And whoever delays, there is no sin on him either, for whoever is mindful of Allah.

q: Of the sacrificial animals, Surah Al-Hajj says to eat from them and feed whom?
مِنَ الأَنْعَامِ المُهْدَاةِ، قَالَتْ سُورَةُ الحَجِّ كُلُوا مِنْهَا وَأَطْعِمُوا مَنْ؟
x: Sacrifice is also charity: the meat is shared with those in need.

q: According to Surah Al-Hajj, what of the sacrifice reaches Allah?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الحَجِّ، مَا الَّذِي يَنَالُ اللَّهَ مِنَ الأَضَاحِي؟
x: ﴾Their meat will not reach Allah, nor their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you.﴿

q: About the rulings of fasting, what does Surah Al-Baqarah say Allah intends for you?
فِي أَحْكَامِ الصِّيَامِ، مَاذَا قَالَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ إِنَّ اللَّهَ يُرِيدُهُ بِكُمْ؟
x: The verse adds: so that you complete the count, and glorify Allah for guiding you.

q: Which act of worship in the mosques is mentioned at the end of the fasting verse, Surah Al-Baqarah 187?
مَا العِبَادَةُ فِي المَسَاجِدِ المَذْكُورَةُ فِي آخِرِ آيَةِ الصِّيَامِ (البَقَرَةُ 187)؟
x: ﴾…while you are staying for worship in the mosques.﴿

q: How many categories of zakah recipients are listed in Surah At-Tawbah, verse 60?
كَمْ صِنْفًا مِنْ أَهْلِ الزَّكَاةِ ذُكِرَ فِي الآيَةِ 60 مِنْ سُورَةِ التَّوْبَةِ؟
x: The poor, the needy, those who collect it, those whose hearts are to be won over, freeing captives, debtors, in the cause of Allah, and the traveller.

q: Surah Al-Maʿun warns those who pray yet are what about their prayer?
تَتَوَعَّدُ سُورَةُ المَاعُونِ مُصَلِّينَ هُمْ عَنْ صَلَاتِهِمْ...
x: The surah also warns those who show off, and who withhold even small kindnesses.

q: In the wudu verse of Surah Al-Maʾidah, which part is wiped rather than washed?
فِي آيَةِ الوُضُوءِ مِنْ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ، مَا العُضْوُ الَّذِي أُمِرَ بِمَسْحِهِ؟
x: Wudu has its steps in the Quran, and wiping replaces washing for this one part.

q: In the wudu verse, the feet are mentioned up to where?
فِي آيَةِ الوُضُوءِ، إِلَى أَيْنَ ذُكِرَتِ الأَرْجُلُ؟
x: The wudu verse ends: Allah does not intend to make difficulty for you, but to purify you.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, seek help through patience and…
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، اسْتَعِينُوا بِالصَّبْرِ وَ...
x: And it is difficult except for the humbly submissive, who know they will meet their Lord.

q: Which prayer does Surah Al-Israʾ describe as an additional act for the Prophet {saw}, performed at night?
مَا الصَّلَاةُ الَّتِي وَصَفَتْهَا سُورَةُ الإِسْرَاءِ بِأَنَّهَا نَافِلَةٌ لِلنَّبِيِّ {saw} فِي اللَّيْلِ؟
x: Perhaps your Lord will raise you to a praised station.

q: In Hajj tamattuʿ, one who finds no sacrificial animal fasts three days during Hajj and seven on returning. What does Surah Al-Baqarah call the total?
فِي حَجِّ التَّمَتُّعِ، مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدِ الهَدْيَ صَامَ ثَلَاثَةَ أَيَّامٍ فِي الحَجِّ وَسَبْعَةً إِذَا رَجَعَ. بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ المَجْمُوعَ؟
x: This applies to pilgrims whose families do not live near the Sacred Mosque.

q: According to Surah Al-Maʾidah, what may not be killed while in the state of ihram?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ، مَا الَّذِي لَا يَجُوزُ قَتْلُهُ وَأَنْتُمْ حُرُمٌ؟
x: Hunting is forbidden during ihram, and the verse sets a penalty for anyone who does it on purpose.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, spend from which of what you have earned?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، أَنْفِقُوا مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ مِمَّا كَسَبْتُمْ؟
x: Do not aim for the bad to give from it, when you yourselves would not accept it except with closed eyes.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, what invalidates charity?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، مَا الَّذِي يُبْطِلُ الصَّدَقَاتِ؟
o: Reminders of generosity and hurtful words
x: The verse likens such charity to soil on a smooth rock: heavy rain washes it away, leaving it bare.

q: According to Surah Al-Baqarah, charity given openly is good, but what is better?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ، إِبْدَاءُ الصَّدَقَاتِ حَسَنٌ، فَمَا الخَيْرُ مِنْهُ؟
o: Concealing it and giving it to the poor
x: Giving in secret keeps the deed between you and Allah, and He is fully aware of what you do.

q: Surah Al-Insan praises those who give food, despite loving it, to whom?
تُثْنِي سُورَةُ الإِنْسَانِ عَلَى مَنْ يُطْعِمُونَ الطَّعَامَ عَلَى حُبِّهِ لِمَنْ؟
o: The needy, the orphan and the captive
x: They say: we feed you only for the sake of Allah; we want no reward or thanks from you.

q: What does Surah Al-Hajj call the Kaʿbah around which pilgrims circle?
بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ الحَجِّ البَيْتَ الَّذِي يَطُوفُ بِهِ الحُجَّاجُ؟
x: Pilgrims circle the House, fulfil their vows, and remember Allah in the appointed days.

q: In ihram, one who must shave due to illness or an ailment of the head owes what ransom, according to Surah Al-Baqarah?
فِي الإِحْرَامِ، مَنْ كَانَ مَرِيضًا أَوْ بِهِ أَذًى مِنْ رَأْسِهِ، مَا الفِدْيَةُ بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ البَقَرَةِ؟
x: Hair must not be shaved in ihram until the sacrifice reaches its place, unless illness or an ailment requires it.

q: According to Surah Al-Maʾidah, how many needy people are fed as expiation for a broken oath?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ، كَمْ مِسْكِينًا يُطْعَمُ فِي كَفَّارَةِ اليَمِينِ؟
x: Or clothing them, or freeing a slave. The verse adds: keep your oaths.

q: If one cannot find the means for an oath’s expiation, how many days are fasted, according to Surah Al-Maʾidah?
مَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ كَفَّارَةَ اليَمِينِ، كَمْ يَوْمًا يَصُومُ بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ المَائِدَةِ؟
x: That is the expiation of your oaths when you have sworn.

q: In Surah Al-Mujadilah, one unable to fast two consecutive months must feed how many poor people?
فِي سُورَةِ المُجَادِلَةِ، مَنْ لَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ صِيَامَ شَهْرَيْنِ مُتَتَابِعَيْنِ يُطْعِمُ كَمْ مِسْكِينًا؟
x: Each step of the expiation comes with a lighter option for those who cannot manage the one before.

q: Which of these does Surah Al-Baqarah forbid during Hajj?
أَيٌّ مِمَّا يَلِي نَهَتْ عَنْهُ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ فِي الحَجِّ؟
x: There is to be no obscenity, no wickedness and no disputing during Hajj.

q: What does Surah Al-Hajj call the sacrificial camels (al-budn)?
بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ الحَجِّ البُدْنَ؟
o: Among the wealth of the rich
Among the signs of the Hour
x: The verse adds: in them there is good for you, so mention Allah’s name over them.

q: In the fear prayer described in Surah An-Nisaʾ, how do the believers pray?
فِي صَلَاةِ الخَوْفِ المَوْصُوفَةِ فِي سُورَةِ النِّسَاءِ، كَيْفَ يُصَلِّي المُؤْمِنُونَ؟
o: One group prays with him while another stands guard
They delay it to the next day
x: Then the other group comes and prays with him, while they keep their weapons and stay on guard.

q: Complete: ﴾Indeed, good deeds do away with…﴿
x: The verse ends: that is a reminder for those who remember.

q: In Surah Al-Muzzammil, how much of the Quran are the believers told to recite?
فِي سُورَةِ المُزَّمِّلِ، كَمْ أُمِرَ المُؤْمِنُونَ أَنْ يَقْرَؤُوا مِنَ القُرْآنِ؟
x: Allah knows some of you are ill, travelling, or striving, so He made it easy.

q: When asked what they should spend, what answer does Surah Al-Baqarah give?
لَمَّا سَأَلُوا مَاذَا يُنْفِقُونَ، بِمَاذَا أَجَابَتْ سُورَةُ البَقَرَةِ؟
x: Allah makes His signs clear so that you may reflect.

q: How does Surah Al-Maʿarij describe those who pray?
بِمَاذَا وَصَفَتْ سُورَةُ المَعَارِجِ المُصَلِّينَ؟
x: The passage lists the qualities of those who pray, beginning with constancy.

q: Complete the duʿa: ﴾Our Lord, give us good in this world and good in the Hereafter, and protect us from…﴿
x: One short duʿa that covers both lives: good in this world, good in the Hereafter, and safety from the Fire.

q: Complete the duʿa: ﴾My Lord, increase me in…﴿
x: Allah taught His Prophet {saw} this duʿa right after telling him not to hurry to recite the Quran before its revelation was complete.

q: Allah says: ﴾So remember Me; I will…﴿
x: ﴾So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me.﴿

q: Complete Musa’s {as} duʿa: ﴾My Lord, expand for me my…﴿
x: Musa made this duʿa when he was sent to Firʿawn, asking also that his task be made easy and his tongue untied.

q: Allah says: ﴾I respond to the call of the caller when he…﴿
x: ﴾And when My servants ask you about Me, indeed I am near.﴿

q: Complete the duʿa of Ibrahim and Ismaʿil: ﴾Our Lord, accept from us; indeed You are the All-Hearing, the…﴿
أَكْمِلْ دُعَاءَ إِبْرَاهِيمَ وَإِسْمَاعِيلَ: {Q:2:127:8-13} ...
x: Ibrahim and Ismaʿil made this duʿa while raising the foundations of the Kaʿbah.

q: Complete: ﴾My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of…﴿
x: The closing verse of Surah Al-Muʾminun.

q: In Ibrahim’s {as} duʿa, whom does he ask forgiveness for, besides himself and the believers?
فِي دُعَاءِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ {as}، لِمَنْ طَلَبَ المَغْفِرَةَ مَعَ نَفْسِهِ وَالمُؤْمِنِينَ؟
x: ﴾Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers on the Day the account is established.﴿

q: How does Surah Al-Ahzab command the believers to remember Allah?
كَيْفَ أَمَرَتْ سُورَةُ الأَحْزَابِ المُؤْمِنِينَ أَنْ يَذْكُرُوا اللَّهَ؟
x: Remembrance is not only for special moments: believers are told to remember Allah often, throughout their day.

q: According to Surah Al ʿImran, in which positions do people of understanding remember Allah?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ آلِ عِمْرَانَ، عَلَى أَيِّ أَحْوَالٍ يَذْكُرُ أُولُو الأَلْبَابِ اللَّهَ؟
o: Standing, sitting and lying on their sides
x: And they reflect on the creation of the heavens and the earth.

q: How does Surah Al-Aʿraf say to call upon your Lord?
كَيْفَ أَمَرَتْ سُورَةُ الأَعْرَافِ بِدُعَاءِ الرَّبِّ؟
x: Indeed, He does not like transgressors.

q: Complete the duʿa: ﴾Our Lord, forgive us our sins and our excesses, and make our feet…﴿
x: This was the duʿa of believers who stood with earlier prophets: whatever befell them, they did not weaken or give in.

q: In Surah Al-Muʾminun, from what are we taught to seek refuge: ﴾My Lord, I seek refuge in You from…﴿
فِي سُورَةِ المُؤْمِنُونَ، مِنْ أَيِّ شَيْءٍ نَسْتَعِيذُ: {Q:23:97:1-5} ...
x: The next verse adds: ﴾and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they come near me﴿.

q: Complete Surah Ash-Sharh: ﴾And to your Lord…﴿
x: The verse before it says: when you have finished your duties, stand up for worship. Then turn all your hope to your Lord.

q: According to Surah Al-Aʿraf, when should you remember your Lord?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ الأَعْرَافِ، مَتَى تَذْكُرُ رَبَّكَ؟
x: Humbly, with awe, and without raising your voice.

q: According to Surah Qaf, when should you glorify your Lord with praise?
بِحَسَبِ سُورَةِ ق، مَتَى تُسَبِّحُ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ؟
x: The verse begins with patience: bear patiently what they say, and glorify your Lord with praise.

q: Surah As-Saffat ends: ﴾And praise be to Allah, Lord of…﴿
x: The surah closes with three verses: glory to your Lord above what they describe, peace upon the messengers, and praise to Allah.

q: Complete the duʿa for parents: ﴾My Lord, have mercy upon them as they…﴿
o: brought me up when I was small
x: The duʿa asks Allah to repay parents with mercy for the years they spent raising us.

q: Which prophet prayed: ﴾My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and from my descendants﴿?
x: One of several duʿas Ibrahim {as} made for himself and his descendants in Surah Ibrahim.

q: Complete: ﴾Our Lord, do not let our hearts deviate after You have…﴿
x: Guidance is a gift, and this duʿa asks Allah to keep it, not just to give it.
قَالَ تَعَالَى: {Q:3:8}.

q: Complete: ﴾Our Lord, grant us from our spouses and offspring comfort to our…﴿
x: Comfort of the eyes: a family that brings joy because they walk in goodness.

q: Complete: ﴾Our Lord, do not take us to task if we forget or…﴿
x: Part of the closing duʿas of Al-Baqarah, asking Allah for forgiveness and mercy.
